旧自定义仍保留，不自动覆盖。进入“手机操作与辅助选项→逐按钮编辑→左侧选键菜单→使用推荐十字布局（保存后替换两方向）”，保存后采用左十字、右动作键；只改草稿，取消恢复原布局/大小/快捷键状态，重置仍仅本方向。继承b5尺寸回跳与连续加减保存修复。

### 本地性能诊断（默认关闭）
选项→本地性能诊断→开始记录并返回游戏。玩到开局、死亡/复活或持续卡顿后，再打开选项→停止性能记录并查看报告→复制报告反馈。

apps.name: AirCard-iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Customize Apple Wallet card artwork, lock screen passcode dialers and PosterBoard wallpapers directly on device, without a jailbreak. Requires iOS 27 or newer, LocalDevVPN running in loopback mode, and Developer Mode pairing.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed in v1.3.2 🚀

This update brings full feature parity with AirCard macOS v1.2.6, restores robust card discovery across all iOS versions, introduces automatic bank/network recognition with custom card nicknames, delivers an ultra-fast tunnel cache (0.02s connections), and completely resolves wallpaper flashing for Collections and Mercury wallpapers.

### 💳 Wallet Card Discovery & Bank Identification
• **Universal Wallet Log Parser**: Ported the proven `WalletScanParser` from AirCard macOS. Captures cards from `Dashboard loading (...): for SOO+`, `passIDs[InSession]`, `passIDs[global]`, and modern JSON NFC activations (`"identifier": "HEX"`).
• **Automatic Bank & Network Detection**: Recognizes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UnionPay, Discover, and JCB via applet AIDs during selection.
• **Card Nicknames (Rename)**: Added a direct **Rename** button (✏️) so you can give your cards friendly names like *"Monobank"*, *"Salary Card"*, or *"Revolut"*, safely persisted in app settings.
• **28-Character Fallback Token Matcher**: Restores dependable card discovery on devices where standard log patterns are redacted.

### ⚡ Ultra-Fast Tunnel Routing (from 10s to 0.02s!)
• **Working Route Caching**: `rust-core` now caches the active RSD connection route (`LAST_WORKING_ROUTE`), eliminating repeated port and interface scanning.
• **RSD-First Priority**: Connects directly via RemoteXPC on port 49152, bypassing slow Lockdown retries and broken pipes on iOS 18+.
• **Eliminated Loopback Policy Drops**: Removed local loopback attempts that caused `policy drop` control channel errors.

### 🖼 Wallpapers (.tendies) — Collections & Mercury Fixes
• **Dual Injection on iOS 18+**: Wallpapers are now injected into both their primary bundle (`com.apple.WallpaperKit.CollectionsPoster` or `com.apple.MercuryPoster`) and the modern iOS 18+ application container (`com.apple.Posters.CollectionsPosterApp` / `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp`).
• **Metadata Synchronization**: Fixed a critical issue where `Wallpaper.plist`'s numeric identifier was randomized out-of-sync with `suggestionMetadata.plist` (`7400.DYNAMIC`), causing wallpapers like Windows 11 to vanish from the Lock Screen gallery.
• **Mercury Wallpaper Support**: Added recognition for `mercury-descriptors` container folders and registered `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp` in `PersistedPosterContainerBundleIdentifiers`.
• **NeoSpring Respring**: Instant springboard reload to apply wallpaper preferences immediately.

### 🧪 Quality & Testing
• All 24 unit tests passing (`TendiesEngineTests`, `WalletScanParserTests`, `CardPhotoCropTests`, `CardPhotoPickerTests`).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mak5er/AirCard-iOS/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2

apps.localizedDescription: AniBaka 是一个基于 Flutter 的跨平台番剧聚合与媒体播放客户端，支持多番剧源、弹幕、字幕、离线缓存与本地媒体库，并提供动漫实时超分辨率画质增强。

versions.localizedDescription:
本次更新重点优化手机端打开番剧详情和返回的体验，新增本地字体导入，并更新四个内置播放源。

### 界面与交互

- **优化番剧详情转场。** 点击卡片后，圆角小窗口从封面位置逐渐铺满全屏，返回时收回卡片。适配 Android 预测性返回和 iOS 侧滑返回手势。
- **支持导入自定义字体。** 在「设置 → 外观 → 导入字体」选择本地 `.ttf` 或 `.otf` 文件，重启应用后会恢复已导入的字体。
- **调整移动端底部导航。** 优化拖动切换和随滚动收起、显示的交互。社区发帖按钮随底栏一同收起。

### 性能优化/修复

- 优化 Android 首页触摸采样和海报网格绘制，减轻慢速滚动时的细节抖动。
- 减少封面加载、详情刷新和播放选源时的重复处理。内存紧张时释放部分后台标签页。
- 修复ios和macos异常播放器黑屏的问题。

### 播放

- 修复部分 HLS 视频因上游返回重复响应头而无法正常读取分片的问题。

### 平台兼容

- 统一 Android 各架构安装包的版本号，避免同一版本因架构不同而被识别为不同构建。
- 同步 iOS 和 macOS 的媒体库与播放器渲染插件版本，并更新 Windows 打包流程以兼容六位构建号。
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AniBakaBaka/AniBaka/compare/5.2.4+1101...5.2.5+261113

- 支持绑定、更换找回邮箱，通过邮箱验证码修改或找回密码；已填写 QQ 的账户可直接使用对应 QQ 邮箱找回。
- 优化自动搜源与换源逻辑，减少重复加载，修复短标题误匹配及历史匹配记录可能关联到其他作品的问题。
- 优化媒体代理、播放鉴权与 HLS 处理，更新部分内置源，改善播放兼容性与去广告处理。
- 优化弹幕加载，减少重复请求，修复部分弹幕颜色解析错误，以及切集后旧弹幕加载结果覆盖当前内容的问题。
- 调整番剧详情、评分、角色、收藏和评论界面，优化桌面播放器侧栏与剧集缩略图展示。
- 公告与置顶评论支持关闭后记住状态，内容更新后再次提示。
- 优化 Bangumi 数据缺失及请求异常的处理，完善网络设置说明。
- 修复 Windows 首次构建可能遗漏原生依赖的问题，并增加发行包依赖校验。
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AniBakaBaka/AniBaka/compare/5.2.2+1017...5.2.3+1020

Apollo-Reborn is the community-maintained Apollo sideload build powered by the Apollo-Reborn tweak.

It restores custom API support, media fixes, uploads, inline media, translation, saved categories, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Liquid Glass support on iOS 26+, and the rest of the project’s ongoing fixes and enhancements.

These sources are intended for AltStore Classic, SideStore, and Feather. Apollo-Reborn is not compatible with AltStore PAL.

Choose the source variant that matches how you sideload:

• Standard: full app bundle with Apollo’s working extensions plus Apollo-Reborn widgets
• No Extensions: strips app extensions, including widgets, to reduce App ID usage on free Apple IDs
• GLASS: adds the Liquid Glass iOS 26 patch and bundled Liquid Glass icon catalog
• No Extensions + GLASS: combines both options

The extension-bearing builds (Standard and GLASS) register about 7 App IDs, one per bundled app extension. A free Apple ID can register 10 App IDs per 7 days, so a clean single install fits, but it is easy to exceed if you install under more than one bundle ID, reinstall within the same week, or sideload other extension-bearing apps. If an install fails with an App ID error, use a No Extensions build (1 App ID) or wait for older App IDs to expire. A paid Apple Developer account has a much higher cap.

This project is not affiliated with Apollo or Christian Selig.

versions.localizedDescription:
# DukeX v1.0.2 - Expanding the Xbox Experience

DukeX v1.0.2 is our biggest step yet toward preserving the full original Xbox
experience, not just the games. This release introduces the first native macOS
build, expands XB.Live integration, and brings richer community features to both
iOS and macOS.

## What's New

- Native macOS release: DukeX is now available as a Mac Catalyst desktop build
  packaged with a nested Xemu fork, pairing desktop Xemu compatibility with the
  DukeX interface.
- XB.Live Rich Presence and playtime tracking: friends can see what you are
  playing while DukeX tracks supported playtime sessions.
- XB.Live messaging: threaded conversations, friend messaging, unread
  indicators, supported game invites, and existing Xbox inbox support now live
  inside DukeX.
- XB.Live social expansion: friend requests, friend management, online presence,
  and deeper community integration are available from the Profile experience.
- Activity Feed: XB.Live news, friend online status, friend achievement unlocks,
  and community updates now appear in a continuously refreshed timeline.
- Controller Landscape Mode: on iOS, compatible controllers can switch DukeX
  into a controller-first browsing and launch experience.
- Expanded AirPlay and external display support: big-screen play is more
  reliable across supported display configurations.

## Improvements

- Improved achievements with Games, Apps, and Cores grouping plus updated
  artwork handling for XB.Live Core, DukeX Core, and special test titles.
- Improved game tile spacing and cover handling across iOS and macOS.
- Improved XB.Live cloud-save sync metadata with console identity v2,
  content-hash dedupe, and server-assisted cross-console restore handling.
- Fixed achievement progress rounding so time-based achievements do not show
  100% before they are actually complete.

## Availability

- iOS: install `DukeX.v1.0.2.ipa` through StikStore, SideStore, or another
  supported sideloading workflow.
- macOS: install `DukeX.macOS.v1.0.2.dmg` by dragging DukeX to Applications.
- Hardware requirements on iOS remain Apple A14 Bionic or Apple M1 hardware or
  newer.
- iOS 16.0 or later is supported, with iOS 16 support remaining experimental.

## Important

DukeX does not include Xbox system files, game images, BIOS files, copyrighted
content, signing certificates, or user games. Users must provide their own
legally obtained files. DukeX is intended for legitimate emulation,
preservation, testing, and personal library use.

apps.name: Fathom
apps.localizedDescription:
An x86-64 PC emulator for iOS. Fathom runs x86-64 Linux programs on an iPhone or iPad by translating them to ARM64 as they execute, using FEXCore - the dynamic recompiler behind FEX-Emu - with a native SwiftUI front end.

Import a statically linked x86-64 Linux executable, open it, press Run. Fathom maps it into a guest address space, hands its instructions to FEXCore's JIT, answers its Linux syscalls, and shows you its output.

JIT requires StikDebug to attach to the process and service the executable-memory traps; Fathom asks for this automatically on launch when it is missing.

Please note: only statically linked, position-independent executables (-static-pie) run today. Dynamically linked binaries and 32-bit x86 are not supported yet, and threads are not implemented, so a guest runs single-threaded.

versions.localizedDescription:
An x86-64 PC emulator for iOS, running guest code on FEXCore.

2048 and tic tac toe both run. Add them from the Library tab and play with the on-screen arrow keys.

**Downloads**
- `Fathom.ipa` - the app, unsigned, for sideloading. Needs StikDebug attached for JIT.
- `tictactoe` - arrows move, Enter places, against a minimax bot that cannot be beaten.
- `play2048` - arrows slide the board.

Copy the two game binaries into Fathom's Programs folder, or import them from the Library tab.

apps.name: Husk
apps.localizedDescription: Run Android apps on iOS: drop in an APK, tap it, and the Android app opens full-screen on a QEMU guest with hardware-accelerated display and audio. Needs JIT plus a debugger attached at runtime, so it requires a sideloading setup that can provide get-task-allow rather than a plain re-sign.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's new?

3.4 is a compatibility release. About 97% of the 472 F-Droid apps we test now run, up from 85%. On the 169 Play Store apps we test, about 90% run, not counting apps with anti-tamper or fraud protection, which Husk doesn't try to bypass. All of these numbers are from testing on a Mac.

### More Android apps
- Microsoft Word opens (Excel and PowerPoint share its libraries)
- Slack, Gmail, Teams, Deezer, Flipboard and Picsart get past the crashes that stopped them
- More engines and frameworks start: React Native's new architecture, Qt 6 / QML, and apps using JavaScriptCore
- libGDX and other OpenGL apps draw again (3.3 broke these)
- Apps that keep secrets in Android's secure key store work better
- Apps with big bundled databases open
- UPnP and network discovery apps can start
- Apps that declare their launch screen in a split APK can start

### Looks better
- Rounded buttons are proper pills instead of ellipses
- Toolbars, window backgrounds and more color formats behave like they do on a phone

### Less "out of memory"
- Fewer `OutOfMemoryError: pthread_create` crashes on installs without extended address space
- Unity games use less address space on sideloaded installs, and keep their frame rate up
- New in Settings -> Performance: see whether Increased Memory Limit and Extended Address Space are on for your install

### Also
- Japanese, thanks to @Yuki-1018
- Fixed Husk crashing when importing a `.p12`, or at launch with one saved on iOS 27 (#220)
- The Remove and Uninstall dialogs open next to their buttons on iPad (#218)
- Winlator's Settings page no longer crashes
- Husk builds with Xcode 27 and the iOS 27 SDK

## Known Issues
- Without JIT, Minecraft, some Flutter apps and some LÖVE games can fail. Use StikJIT for those for now
- Browsers (Firefox, Brave, Opera) don't run yet because they need separate helper processes
- Husk's Java runtime still has no garbage collector, so big apps can run out of memory in long sessions (#191)
- Touch doesn't work yet in Godot 3 games (#200)
- Apps with anti-tamper still won't run, and neither will apps that need Google Play services or a Google account
- Winlator containers don't run
- Full Android is still slow. Use the translation layer for games

## Thanks
Thanks to @BartolomeoRusso9, @Dey410 and @Yuki-1018 for their pull requests, and to everyone who sent logs. Crash reports are what made this release possible ❤️

## Links
- Website: https://itslevii.dev

## Play without JIT
More games convert and sign their libraries on the device. One library that cannot convert no longer stops the rest. Certificates from SideStore, AltStore, or a `.p12` import more reliably, and converted libraries are signed again after this update.

## More Android apps
Java apps pick up missing platform classes from AOSP when `framework.jar` is bundled. Jobs and boot receivers actually start, and Wi-Fi, location, and settings answer as a running phone would.

## Importing files
The in-app file picker for Android apps can be used more than once in a session.

## 32-bit ARM apps
APKs that only ship `armeabi-v7a` libraries are translated to arm64. This path is still incomplete (Minecraft PE is the current test case).

## Fixes
Certificate import, leftover store passwords on a `.p12`, the file picker after the first pick, game pages on iOS 15, and StikDebug when Husk is inside a container app.

## What's new?
- New UI, all over
    - New Home, Library, Store and game pages
    - Every screen, Settings included, uses the same navy look
- Husk accounts
    - Sign in from the top of Settings
    - Your profile, playtime and library sync with itslevii.dev
- New Import screen: APK, split APKs (.xapk, .apkm, .apks), OBBs and PS4 game folders. On iPad you can drag files onto it.
- Small icon size for the library
- Chinese (Simplified) for all of Husk. The language you pick in setup is used by Husk and your apps.
### Store
- New app page
    - Proper descriptions (bold, lists, links)
    - Short counts, like 1B+ downloads and 37M reviews
    - Tap screenshots to view them full screen, with zoom
    - Trailers, What's New, Highlights, tags and developer links
- Store downloads can be stopped, and show in Downloads
### Android
- Keyboard button for apps and games. Typing works even when there's no text box.
- In-app file picker: when an app asks for a file, the iOS file picker opens
- Fullscreen games are centered and use the whole screen (Plants vs. Zombies and more)
- Cocos Creator games start
- Godot 4.7 games can save
- Flutter apps find their fonts

## Husk 3.0
The coolest and biggest Husk release yet. Hundreds of new Android games, PS4 support, and more.

## What's new?
- Console-style home screen
- New library UI
- Proper first run
    - Contains full setup guide + optional walkthrough
### PS4 Games
- Add a game with the + button. Either a PKG, a folder of PKG's, or an extracted game folder. Updates install with their game.
- Tested: Bloodborne, Minecraft: PlayStation 4 Edition, Sonic Mania
- Shaders are kept inbetween launches with Shader Cache
- If a game requires keyboard input, it'll open the iOS keyboard
### Android
- 366 newly working games - view in compatibility list
- Unofficial ports: Sonic Robo Blast 2, Nethack, PokeWilds and more
- GoDot 4
- Store downloads include OBB files
- Typing works in all games
- Optional language fonts (chinese, japanese, etc)
### Also
- Lots of fixes
- TrollStore JIT fully complete
- iOS 15.5 support
## Known Issues
- Bloodborne runs, but very poorly.
- Some Unity 6 games can render slowly
## Final notes
Thank you all. Enjoy ❤️

apps.name: Kumone
apps.localizedDescription:
Kumone（雲の音）— native NetEase Cloud Music client for iOS. Talks directly to NetEase's real API with no third-party server: QR-code login, gray-track unblocking, synced lyrics with translation, immersive artwork-tinted now-playing, and playlist management.

Supports English and Simplified Chinese localization.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Fixed

- **iOS**: the mini player briefly lost its layout after leaving the Now Playing screen — the accessory placement reads nil for a few seconds while the zoom transition returns it to the tab bar, and the last reported placement is now kept through that interval.

### Improved

- **iOS + macOS**: every request is now routed through NetEase's eapi as the desktop client, as mygo-cloudmusic does; phone-number login and following an artist answer -460 (检测到您的网络环境存在风险) through the eapi, so those calls and the SMS code go through the plain web API, and the QR login uses type 3 with the /nuser/account/get account lookup, as the desktop client does.

---

### 修复

- **iOS**：从正在播放页面返回后，迷你播放器会短暂丢失布局——缩放过渡回到标签栏的几秒内 accessory 位置读取为 nil，现在这段时间内保留上一次上报的位置。

### 改进

- **iOS + macOS**：所有请求改走网易云的 eapi 并以桌面客户端身份发送，参照 mygo-cloudmusic 的做法；手机号登录和关注歌手在 eapi 下返回 -460（检测到您的网络环境存在风险），这几个调用和短信验证码改走普通 Web API，扫码登录改用 type 3 并通过 /nuser/account/get 查询账号，与桌面客户端一致。

### Added

- **iOS + macOS**: offline downloads — download songs and whole playlists for offline listening, with a 「已下载」 library and a storage page to see usage and manage space. Thanks @xyspg (#111).
- **macOS**: customizable keyboard shortcuts for playback actions, plus optional system-wide (global) hotkeys — set them under Settings → 快捷键. Global hotkeys are off by default. Thanks @WillowBranch127 (#125, closes #122).
- **iOS + macOS**: iCloud sync (off by default) — continue playback where another device left off, keep settings in sync, and optionally share your sign-in between devices through iCloud Drive or a folder you choose. Shared sign-ins are encrypted with a sync password you set, and signing out revokes the session once no other device is using it. Thanks @yamakze (#138).

### Fixed

- **iOS + macOS**: NetEase audio now retries on the twin CDN host when one host is unreachable — fixing playback that occasionally stalled mid-queue (progress kept running) or wouldn't replay a just-played song on a poor network. Thanks @xyspg (#115, closes #106).
- **macOS**: AutoMix no longer jumps the playhead backward (misaligning the progress bar and lyrics) when you pause and then resume. Thanks @WillowBranch127 (#126).
- **macOS**: AutoMix no longer drops out briefly when you resume after a pause. Thanks @XerWandeRer (#140, closes #136).
- **macOS**: scrolling the lyrics with a trackpad or mouse wheel no longer snaps back to the current line, and lines stay unblurred while you scroll. Thanks @xyspg (#139).
- **macOS**: the window buttons stay in place on the immersive now-playing page. Thanks @yxxbc (#130, closes #128).
- **macOS**: the Settings sub-pages (存储空间, 快捷键) have a back button that no longer overlaps the window controls, and Settings reopens on its main page. Thanks @yamakze (#135).

### Improved

- **iOS + macOS**: the now-playing page uses far less CPU — on macOS about 5% of a core while playing instead of about 50% — and frees its memory while the window is minimised. Thanks @yxxbc (#129, closes #131).
- **macOS**: large playlists such as Liked Songs (1,000+ songs) scroll and load much more smoothly, artwork is decoded at the size it is shown, and the sidebar animates with less work. After updating, each cached song is downloaded once more on its next play. Thanks @morefreefg (#127).
- **macOS**: Settings is tidier — AutoMix shows its options only when it is on, keyboard shortcuts switch between in-app and global with a segmented control, and clearing the song cache now runs right away without a confirmation. Thanks @yamakze (#135).
- **macOS**: on macOS 26 and later the app now uses the current system window style. Thanks @yxxbc (#130).

---

### 新增

- **iOS + macOS**：离线下载——可下载单曲和整个歌单离线收听,新增「已下载」库和存储用量 / 管理页。感谢 @xyspg（#111）。
- **macOS**：可自定义播放等操作的键盘快捷键,并支持可选的全局(系统级)快捷键——在 设置 → 快捷键 里设置,全局快捷键默认关闭。感谢 @WillowBranch127（#125，关闭 #122）。
- **iOS + macOS**：iCloud 同步(默认关闭)——在另一台设备上接续播放、同步设置,并可通过 iCloud 云盘或自选文件夹在设备间共享登录。共享的登录信息以你设置的同步密码加密,退出登录时若已没有其他设备在用该会话,会一并注销。感谢 @yamakze（#138）。

### 修复

- **iOS + macOS**：网易云音频在某个 CDN 主机不可达时会自动重试其孪生主机——修复了弱网下偶发的「队列中途卡住(进度还在走)」和「刚听过的歌无法重播」。感谢 @xyspg（#115，关闭 #106）。
- **macOS**：AutoMix 暂停后恢复播放时,播放头不再往回跳(导致进度条和歌词错位)。感谢 @WillowBranch127（#126）。
- **macOS**：AutoMix 暂停后恢复播放时不再短暂断音。感谢 @XerWandeRer（#140，关闭 #136）。
- **macOS**：用触控板或鼠标滚轮翻看歌词时不再被拉回当前句,滚动期间歌词也不再模糊。感谢 @xyspg（#139）。
- **macOS**：沉浸式播放页上的窗口按钮不再错位。感谢 @yxxbc（#130，关闭 #128）。
- **macOS**：设置的二级页面(存储空间、快捷键)返回按钮不再与窗口控件重叠,重新打开设置时回到首页。感谢 @yamakze（#135）。

### 改进

- **iOS + macOS**：播放页的 CPU 占用大幅降低——macOS 上播放时约占 5% 个核心,此前约 50%——窗口最小化时还会释放内存。感谢 @yxxbc（#129，关闭 #131）。
- **macOS**：「我喜欢的音乐」等大歌单(1000 首以上)加载和滚动更流畅,封面按显示尺寸解码,侧边栏动画开销更小。更新后,已缓存的歌曲下次播放时会重新下载一次。感谢 @morefreefg（#127）。
- **macOS**：设置更简洁——AutoMix 仅在开启后显示子选项,快捷键用分段控件切换应用内 / 全局,清除歌曲缓存改为直接执行,不再弹出确认。感谢 @yamakze（#135）。
- **macOS**：在 macOS 26 及以上版本,应用改用当前的系统窗口样式。感谢 @yxxbc（#130）。

**Message:** fix #1644 #1655 #1666, bump bersion

This is a nightly release [created automatically with GitHub Actions workflow](https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer/actions/runs/39017541871/attempts/1).

# LiveContainer 3.8.0

> [!Warning]
> The standalone version requires **SideStore 0.6.2+** or **AltStore 2.2.1+** for installation.
> To install LiveContainer with built-in SideStore (`LiveContainer+SideStore.ipa`), please use [Impactor](https://github.com/khcrysalis/Impactor) or [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader). See [our installation guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/installation/lc_sidestore) for details.

# New Features

## Storage Management

- Added a new storage management view with a breakdown of app bundles, containers, temporary files, app group data, tweaks, and other files. (Hidden apps' size is included in "other" section until unlocked)
- Added per-app storage details, including app bundle size, container sizes, and last-used date.
- Added actions to clean temporary files and caches, including guest app caches and LiveContainer's own caches.

## Multiple LiveContainers
- Added configurable launch priority for multiple LiveContainer instances, making shared-app shortcuts choose available instances in the order you prefer. (#1367)

## Share to Apps in LiveContainer
Added a share extension to LiveContainer. When you share a URL or a file from iOS's share sheet, LiveContainer will ask which app you would like to open the URL/file in, so the old share to LiveContainer shortcut method is no longer needed. When an ipa file is shared in this way, LiveContainer will ask if you want to install it in LiveContainer or in the built-in SideStore (if installed) (#1357)

## Multitasking

- Added per-app multitask preferences. Each app can now follow the global setting, always launch in multitask mode, or avoid multitask mode. (#1208)
- Improved multitask dock behavior: the dock can be made smaller, hidden more cleanly, and has improved padding. (#1228, #1250)
- Added more multitask window animations and improved native-window scene handling.
- URL schemes and `open-url` payloads can be passed to already-running multitask apps and native windows.

## JIT
- Added StosDebug support as a JIT enabler.

## TweakLoader
You can now disable tweaks in the "Tweaks" page in LiveContainer's UI. by @SAOMDVN

# Improvements
- Added support for manually setting a container's IDFV. (#1194)
- IDFV spoofing works even when Tweakloader is not loaded.
- Reworked signing logic for tweaks and app installation, with multithreaded signing support.
- Download alerts now block tab switching while a download is in progress.
- Crash reports are shown in a sheet instead of a large alert for better performance on newer iOS versions.
- Add a "Clear Notification" button (#1388)
- Added some popular NSBonjourServices keys so apps can discover AirPlay devices and remote pairing pairable hosts in the local network. (#1417)

# Bug Fixes

- Fixed `livecontainer://open-url` dropping the deep link when launching an app from a cold start. (#1339)
- Fixed the Add to Home Screen menu failing or behaving incorrectly by replacing the SwiftUI context menu implementation. (#1209)
- Fixed a crash when opening Container Preferences if the app did not contain an `en.lproj` path. (#1239)
- Fixed apps and AltStore sources not being searchable in some cases. (#1365, #1368)
- Fixed converting a shared app back to private after aborting an install with the same bundle identifier, which could leave stale container state behind. (#1347)
- Fixed shortcuts and JIT flows getting stuck on a busy LiveContainer instance instead of using another available instance. (#1386)
- Fixed file picker not workings for some apps because Tweakloader is not loaded after enabling "Hide LiveContainer from dyld API". (#1430)
- Fixed several app launch compatibility issues on iOS 26.5 beta, and some multitask/JIT app launches. (#1300, #1310, #1329)
- Fixed multitask keyboard focus issues on iOS 17.4+, including cases where the keyboard would not appear, Passwords would immediately close, or video playback would freeze in multitask mode. (#1402, #844, #870)
- Added support for iOS 27 developer beta. (#1394, #1417, #1416)
- Fix background downloads in multitask apps (choosing "Keep App Extensions (Register App ID for Each Extension)" is required). (#1415)

# Localization

- Updated translations. Added Spanish translation by @Deci8BelioS

# Credits

Thanks to everyone who contributed code, fixes, testing, and reports for this release, including @boa-z, @ruri1208, @Project516, @yazdipour, @stossy11, and @SAOMDVN.

Great thanks to everyone who helped translate LiveContainer.

apps.name: Madeira
apps.localizedDescription: Madeira runs unmodified x86-64 Windows PC games inside a single jailed iOS app: FEX-Emu translates the game's x86 code to ARM64 as it runs, Wine 11.4 built for ARM64EC provides Windows itself, and DXMT plus Madeira's own Direct3D 12 runtime draw Direct3D 9, 10, 11 and 12 through Metal. Games come with a library, Steam sign-in and installs, controller and touch controls, and keyboard, mouse and trackpad input. Requires an iPhone on iOS 26 or later with JIT enabled through StikDebug.

versions.localizedDescription:
### New
- **More stores.** Madeira has a new **GOG** section: sign in with GOG's own login page, see your library, download and update games with the DLC you own, verify and repair them, and play with Galaxy achievements and stats (Madeira stands in for GOG Galaxy). A new **EA app** section: sign in, see your library and download games without the EA app. A new **itch.io** store shows your itch.io games and free games, and downloads and installs them, .7z archives included. **Epic Games** now handles game downloads and cloud saves together.
- **Store tabs.** With more than one store on the library page, a row of tabs at the top (All, Steam, Other, GOG, itch.io, Epic, EA) shows one store at a time. All is the page as before; the tab you pick is remembered.
- **Steam:**
  - DLC downloads with the game, with a switch per DLC
  - beta branches, with beta codes
  - a Workshop page per game
  - achievements
  - choosing the game's language
  - downloading from a PC on the same network
  - faster repairs
  - a switch that turns Steam Cloud off
- **A redesigned library.** Game details pages, a starting screen, and Settings split into pages. You can also turn on a zoomable grid in Settings › Appearance › New library grid.
- **Recommended settings** for many games, with Reset to Recommended. Share Setup sends a game's setup to someone else.
- **Get Help from Claude** on a game's page shares a fixes guide together with your log and config.
- **Translations:** German, Spanish, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian.
- **External drives**, save backups and Home Screen shortcuts.
- **Games and downloads keep running** when you leave Madeira.
- **Wine Mono and Wine Gecko** download for you, without Wine's download windows.
- **Graphics:**
  - MetalFX upscaling per game
  - experimental frame generation
  - a per-game picker for the graphics card the game sees
  - FPS limits, including 40 FPS on 120 Hz screens
  - an optional thermal frame cap
- **The performance overlay** has a Column layout that you can drag anywhere on the screen.
- **Controllers and touch controls:**
  - rumble, adaptive triggers and the lightbar on real controllers
  - an optional DualSense / DirectInput mode
  - gyro aim and turbo
  - touch control gesture zones
  - a size slider per touch control, and the editor's panels close when you tap outside them
  - a **Button style** for touch controls: Glass (Liquid Glass) or Solid (plain opaque buttons), in the in-game menu and in Settings › Appearance
- **On iPad:** Command-V pastes into games, and the mouse wheel scrolls.
- **On iPhone:** a Bluetooth or USB mouse works with AssistiveTouch on; mouse-look no longer stops at the screen edges.
- **JIT:** Madeira offers StikDebug when the built-in helper is not available.

### Fixed

### New
- **In-app JIT: no StikDebug needed.** Madeira can enable JIT by itself through a bundled helper built on StikJIT. On iOS 27 it pairs with the iPhone it runs on: in Settings › Privacy & Security › Developer Mode, tap **Pair with Madeira** and enter the PIN Madeira shows. No computer needed. On iOS 26, import a pairing file instead. The pairing is kept in the Keychain. StikDebug still works. (#127)
- **Play turns JIT on for you.** If JIT is off, Play enables it and then starts the game. The button reads **Starting JIT** meanwhile.
- **Madeira JIT shortcut (iOS 27, optional).** LocalDevVPN's loopback does not work over cellular data. The shortcut connects LocalDevVPN, turns Cellular Data off when there is no Wi-Fi, and puts both back once the game has started, along with any VPN you were using. Add it during setup or in Settings › JIT.
- **Steam Cloud saves** for installed Steam games, on by default. Saves sync before and after you play, and the cloud copy is backed up before it is replaced. (#130)
- **A controller as keyboard and mouse**, chosen per game, with a Controller binds page. DirectInput is now a per-game choice too. (#128)
- **Setup** starts by installing LocalDevVPN when it is missing. It opens once more after this update, so you can pick one of the new JIT options.

### Fixed
- Games start faster: Wine starts as soon as the wineserver is ready, not after a fixed 2 s. (#125)
- Cuphead (#107), Nine Sols (#108) and Hades II (#119, #120) now run, and Steam app info with escaped quotes is read correctly (#118).
- JIT errors now explain the problem and offer a fix: **Pair Again** or **Connect LocalDevVPN**. The error also shows on the Settings tab.

### Known issues
- With Wi-Fi and Cellular Data both off, LocalDevVPN cannot connect, so JIT cannot be enabled, even with the shortcut. Connect LocalDevVPN while a network is available.

### Install
- Requires **iOS 26 or later**. In-app pairing and the Madeira JIT shortcut need iOS 27.
- If your sideloader asks whether to keep app extensions, keep them: Madeira's in-app JIT runs in one.
- The IPA is ad-hoc signed (no certificate) and carries the app's entitlements, including the increased memory limit. Sideload it with your own Apple ID (SideStore, AltStore, Sideloadly, Plume or similar), which signs it for your device.
- First-run setup walks you through JIT. Settings shows JIT and Memory+ with green checks and says **Ready to play**.

### Not included
The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs are not redistributed (see `legal/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`). Building from source: `tools/fetch-vcruntime.md`.

Thanks to Dan Perks ([@danperks](https://github.com/danperks)) for in-app JIT and pairing, Jesse ([@JesseLovelace](https://github.com/JesseLovelace)) for Steam Cloud saves, faster launches and the game fixes, and Nick ([@125hz](https://github.com/125hz)) for keyboard-and-mouse controllers.

versions.localizedDescription: Updated to v0.9.97.

## What's Changed
* fix(appearance): bring back the app-wide Google Fonts picker by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1127
* fix: make the genre chip's searches work, in the source and the library by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1129

* fix(migrate): search a few sources at a time and open the dialog at once by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1141
* fix(sync): persist since and lastSync in one awaited write by @sergwei in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1146
* fix(filters): skip malformed filter options instead of dropping the list by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1150
* feat(library): reopen on the last category, and keep the last row clear

## Why 0.9.95 and not 1.0.0?

This release has almost everything planned for 1.0.0: a new design, a rebuilt player and hundreds of fixes. But so much has changed that it needs testing on more devices and libraries than we can cover ourselves.

So 0.9.95 is the last step before 1.0.0. The goal now is stability, not new features. If something breaks or looks wrong, please [open an issue](https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/issues) with your device and app version. 1.0.0 will come once this version has proven solid.

## Highlights

* **Shiori, a new design for the whole app:** every screen has been redrawn on one design system, with new navigation, transitions and an ergonomic pass throughout (#1077).
* **A rebuilt video player:** new controls on phone, desktop and TV, plus video filters, audio delay, and volume, brightness and fit kept between episodes.
* **A tracker with no account:** follow your status, progress, score and dates on the device alone (#1121).
* **Work that keeps going on Android:** downloads, library updates, restores and syncs continue in the background, under one notification (#1092).
* **More control over downloads and updates:** download ahead while reading, download new chapters automatically, and choose which series a library update skips (#1091).

**Before updating:** this is a large release that also touches how your library is stored, so make a backup first (More > Backup and restore).

## Reader

* Zoom with Ctrl (⌘ on macOS) and the mouse wheel; the wheel alone moves a zoomed page.
* With "Navigate to pan" on, tall pages are read row by row before the page turns.
* Split tall images into slices in webtoon mode.
* Choose which chapters next and previous skip: read, filtered or duplicate.
* Rebind the reader's keyboard shortcuts.
* Separate icons for crop borders on and off.
* Pages and zooms follow your finger more closely, and the webtoon strip glides after a fling.
* Decoded images now have a memory limit, so long chapters no longer keep growing in memory.
* Fixed: lost decoded pages for the next chapter when closing the reader, and chapter list rows with a scanlator failing to lay out.

## Video player

* New controls on phone, desktop and TV, with episodes reachable from the top bar and lock and skip under the timeline on mobile.
* **Video filters:** brightness, contrast, saturation, gamma and hue, kept for the next episodes. Gamma is hidden where the video output cannot apply it.
* **Audio delay:** from -5 to +5 seconds.
* Remember volume and brightness between episodes, and keep the fit from one episode to the next.
* New "Turn subtitles on" switch, so episodes can start without subtitles.
* "Use my subtitle style" now really gives the default style back when turned off.

## What's Changed

* fix(security): show what deep links install and keep tokens out of sh… by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1041
* chore: await dropped writes, add guard lints, localize hardcoded strings by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1042
* refactor: move the tracker library cache from Hive to Isar by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1043
* refactor: split large widget files and remove duplicated code by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1044
* Try to fix chapter sorting by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1035
* Add a protected HLS proxy for extension playback by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1040

* fix(restore): improve error handling and reporting during restore ope… by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1052

* Use neutral icons for extension repositories by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1045
* Add western recommendations and trustworthy watch orders by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1050

apps.name: MiniWatts
apps.localizedDescription: An iPhone battery and charging monitor built on Apple's private APIs: the charger's real watts, how much of that reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and every temperature sensor in the phone. No network code — nothing it reads leaves your phone.

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

## 改进

- **温度可以显示为华氏度。** 设置 → 单位 里可选"自动 / °C / °F"。"自动"跟随系统地区，以及"设置 › 通用 › 语言与地区"里的"温度"选项，所以地区使用华氏度的用户升级后会直接看到 °F。App 各页、图表、热力图、悬浮读数、实时活动和小组件都按所选单位显示；原始数据仍显示传感器给出的 °C。(#25)
- **充电预估。** 充电时，功率页会显示充到 80% 和充到 100% 还要多久，以及大约几点。时间根据电量实际上升的速度推算，不依赖电池能量设置；要等电量变化两次才会出现，通常需要几分钟。80% 以后按典型充电曲线估算，只是近似值。(#27)
- **显示版本号。** 设置 → 关于 里显示当前版本，原始数据导出的第一行也带上了版本号。(#27)
- **iPad 布局。** iPad 横屏和 13 英寸竖屏时，各页分成两栏；窄屏时仍是一栏。历史记录里单次充电的详情页在 iPad 上不再横向铺满。(#22)
- **iPad 热力图。** 在 iPad 上，发热页画的是 iPad 的轮廓，各区域按 iPad Pro 11 英寸的内部布局放置：主板在中间，两侧是电芯，充电芯片在 USB-C 接口旁。设备页和设置里的图标也换成了 iPad。(#13, #22)

## 修复

- 发热：CPU 簇（`pACC`、`eACC`）和图像处理器（`ISP`）等传感器以前被归入"其他传感器"，现在算作 SoC，SoC 区域的温度也会把它们算进去。iPhone 11 上 `FrontCameraDie`、`BCMLBSkin` 这类名字连写的传感器以前会被分错区（比如前摄像头被当成机身），现在会先拆词再归类。(#13, #14)
- 适配器页里"单次采样"那段说明以前在中文界面下一直显示英文，现在已有中文。

## 注意

- iPad 相关的改动只在模拟器里验证过，我手上没有 iPad。如果在 iPad 上看到问题，请从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出并反馈。
- iPad 上"来自充电器"的功率偏低（#13）这次还没有修：要确认其余的输入由哪个传感器测量，需要一份**充电时**导出的原始数据。有 iPad 的话，请在充电时从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出，贴到 #13。
- 充电预估无法知道是否开启了充电上限或优化电池充电。如果开着，电池会在上限前停下，"充到 100%"的时间就不准。

---

## Improvements

- **Temperatures can be shown in Fahrenheit.** Settings → Units offers Automatic, °C or °F. Automatic follows your region and the Temperature option under Settings › General › Language & Region, so if your region uses Fahrenheit you will see °F straight after updating. Every page, the charts, the heat map, the floating meter, the Live Activity and the widget follow the setting; Raw data still shows the sensors' own °C. (#25)
- **Charge forecast.** While charging, the Power page shows how long until 80% and until 100%, and roughly when. It is worked out from how fast the battery level is actually rising, so it does not depend on the battery energy setting; it appears once the level has moved twice, usually within a few minutes. Past 80% it follows a typical charging curve and is approximate. (#27)
- **Version number.** Settings → About shows the installed version, and the first line of the Raw data dump includes it. (#27)
- **iPad layout.** On an iPad in landscape, and a 13-inch in portrait, every page uses two columns; narrower windows keep one. A session's detail page in History no longer stretches edge to edge on an iPad. (#22)
- **iPad heat map.** On an iPad the Thermal page draws an iPad, with the zones placed as in an iPad Pro 11-inch: logic board down the middle, a battery cell either side, the charge IC by the USB-C port. The Devices page and Settings use iPad icons too. (#13, #22)

## Fixes

- Thermal: the CPU-cluster (`pACC`, `eACC`) and image-processor (`ISP`) sensors used to land under "Other sensors"; they now count as the SoC, and the SoC zone's temperature includes them. On an iPhone 11, run-together sensor names such as `FrontCameraDie` and `BCMLBSkin` were filed in the wrong zone (the front camera as chassis); names are now split into words before they are matched. (#13, #14)
- Adapter: the one-sample note always showed in English in the Chinese interface; it is now translated.

## Notes

- The iPad changes were checked in the simulator only — I do not have an iPad. If something looks wrong on yours, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it.
- The low "from charger" reading on an iPad (#13) is not fixed yet: finding which sensor carries the rest of the input needs a Raw data dump taken **while charging**. If you have an iPad, please copy one from Settings → Raw data while it charges and post it on #13.
- The charge forecast cannot tell whether a charge limit or Optimized Battery Charging is on. If one is, the battery stops short and the time to 100% will be wrong.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0

Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

## 改进

- **iPhone 18 Pro 高功率充电时会提示读数可能只有一半。** 在 iPhone 18 Pro 系列上用有线充电、协商功率超过 30 W 时，表盘旁会显示"可能只读到一半"，功率页和适配器页也会说明原因：这种情况下输入和电芯两侧的传感器都可能只测到一半功率。数值本身不做修正。
- **新增"电量核对"。** 充电时，App 会把电量上升的速度换算成功率，和电芯传感器在同一段时间里测到的功率对比。如果电量涨得明显比传感器测到的快（1.6 倍以上），表盘旁会显示"读数偏低"，并给出两边的数值；如果两边一致，会显示核对通过，上面那条"可能只读到一半"的提示也会隐藏。电量要上涨至少 3% 才能给出结果，通常需要几分钟。
- **传感器按 SMC key 识别，重复的读数会合并。** iOS 27 上每个传感器都会出现两份，以前只取第一份，现在取两份的平均值；发热页的列表里每个传感器也只出现一次。发热页和原始数据会在传感器名旁边标出 key（比如电池温度偏高的那个是 `TG0B`）。
- **电池能量按机型给默认值。** iPhone 18 Pro Max 为 21.75 Wh，iPhone 17 Pro Max 为 19.7 Wh，其他机型仍是 15 Wh。设置 → 电池能量 里会显示本机型的额定值，点"使用"即可填入。已经手动设置过的值保持不变。
- **原始数据新增"Derived power checks"一节。** 这一节记录半功率提示是否生效，以及电量核对的结果。

## 修复

- 适配器：iPhone 18 Pro 高功率充电时，读数偏低不再被误判成线材或接口的问题；在无法确认读数完整时，不计算线路电阻和电流利用率。

## 注意

- iPhone 18 Pro 高功率充电时，完整的输入功率仍然读不到：另一路充电电流没有可读的传感器。这个版本只能提示和核对，不能补上缺失的功率；这段时间的充电记录里的能量统计也仍然偏低。
- "电量核对"还没有在 iPhone 18 Pro 上验证过。如果你有这台手机，请在 45 W 充电、电量上涨几个百分点之后，从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出并反馈。
- 如果你的机型不在上面的列表里，请在 设置 → 电池能量 里填入正确的数值，否则电量核对可能一直给不出结论。
- 部分发现来自 ChargeSpeed 作者在 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上的实测。

---

## Improvements

- **The iPhone 18 Pro now warns when a reading may be half.** On an iPhone 18 Pro model charging by cable on a profile above 30 W, the dial shows "may read half", and the Power and Adapter pages explain why: in that mode both the input and the cell sensors can see only half the power. The numbers themselves are not corrected.
- **New battery level check.** While charging, the app turns the battery level's rise into watts and compares it with what the cell sensors measured over the same stretch. If the level rises much faster (1.6× or more), the dial shows "reading low" with both figures; if they agree, the check says so and the "may read half" warning is hidden. It needs at least a 3% rise, usually a few minutes.
- **Sensors are identified by SMC key, and duplicate copies are merged.** iOS 27 publishes every sensor twice. The app used to take the first copy; it now averages the two, and each sensor appears once on the Thermal page. The Thermal page and Raw data show the key beside the name (the battery sensor that runs hot is `TG0B`).
- **Battery energy defaults by model.** 21.75 Wh for the iPhone 18 Pro Max, 19.7 Wh for the iPhone 17 Pro Max, 15 Wh otherwise. Settings → Battery energy shows your model's rating with a "Use" button. A value you set yourself is kept.
- **Raw data gains a "Derived power checks" section**, recording whether the half-reading warning applies and the battery level check's result.

## Fixes

- Adapter: on an iPhone 18 Pro at high power, a low reading is no longer blamed on the cable or plugs; path resistance and current utilisation are not worked out while the reading may be incomplete.

## Notes

- On an iPhone 18 Pro at high power the full input still cannot be read: the second charging path has no readable sensor. This version can warn and cross-check, not fill in the missing power, and energy totals recorded during that time are still low.

Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

## 改进

- **输入读数不完整时，不再当作输入功率显示。** 在 iPad Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上，输入传感器只测到了一部分功率（比如实际 43.5 W 只显示 21.8 W）。现在当进入电芯的功率比输入读数还大时，表盘改为显示"进入电池"的功率，不再计算效率和适配器利用率，并在功率页和适配器页说明原因。
- **电池温度改用中位数。** 部分机型有四个同名的电池温度传感器，其中一个明显偏高。"电池"读数、热力图上的电池标记和分区标题现在都用中位数，四个读数仍然逐个列出。
- **异常温度不再参与计算。** 以下读数不再计入热力图和最高温度，但仍保留在"原始数据"里，并注明原因：低于 −10 °C 的 PMU 传感器、高于 85 °C 而结温对不上的充电芯片温度、恰好为 0.0 °C 的传感器。
- **支持 iPad。** 支持横竖屏，内容不再横向拉满。iPad 的传感器对应关系还没有验证，数据仅供参考。
- **文案更准确。** "来自充电器"改为"手机接口处 / 充电线圈处"；适配器页注明额定功率是协商出的上限，不是功率计读数。
- **原始数据更便于反馈。** 每个传感器带上服务编号，并列出被排除的读数。

## 修复

- 适配器：供电规格列表里不再出现"65.5 V × 65.53 A"这样的无效档位。
- 实时活动：App 在前台时，读数变化 0.05 就会更新，不再等到变化 0.2 W 或 0.5 °C。

## 注意

- 这些修复是根据用户反馈的数据做的，没有在对应机型的真机上验证过。如果你的机型上读数仍然不对，请在 设置 → 原始数据 里复制导出并反馈。
- iPhone 18 Pro Max 高功率充电时的完整输入功率仍然读不到，需要该机型在 45 W 状态下的原始数据导出。
- App 退到后台后，灵动岛上的读数会停住，这是系统限制；想持续看实时读数请使用悬浮表。

---

## Improvements

- **An incomplete input reading is no longer shown as the input.** On an iPad Pro and an iPhone 18 Pro Max the input sensors see only part of the power (21.8 W shown for a real 43.5 W, for one). When more power is reaching the cell than the input reading accounts for, the dial now shows the "into battery" figure, efficiency and adapter utilisation are not worked out, and the Power and Adapter pages say why.
- **Battery temperature is a median.** Some models have four battery temperature sensors under one name, one of them reading clearly high. The Battery readout, the heat map's battery pin and the zone header all use the median now; all four are still listed.
- **Impossible temperatures are left out.** These no longer reach the heat map or the hottest reading, and stay in Raw data with a reason: a PMU sensor below −10 °C, a charge-IC temperature above 85 °C that its junction sensor does not back up, and a sensor at exactly 0.0 °C.
- **iPad support.** All orientations, and content no longer stretches edge to edge. The sensor mapping on iPad is unverified, so treat its numbers with care.
- **More accurate wording.** "From charger" is now "At phone port" / "At charging coil", and the Adapter page says the rating is a negotiated ceiling, not a wall-meter reading.
- **Raw data is easier to report from.** Every sensor carries its service index, and excluded readings are listed.

## Fixes

- Adapter: the profile list no longer shows an invalid "65.5 V × 65.53 A" entry.
- Live Activity: with the app in front, it updates on a 0.05 change instead of waiting for 0.2 W or 0.5 °C.

## Notes

- These fixes were made from data users reported and were not verified on those devices. If readings still look wrong on your model, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it.
- On an iPhone 18 Pro Max the full input power at high-power charging still cannot be read; a Raw data dump taken at 45 W on that model is needed.
- Once the app is in the background the Dynamic Island reading stops. That is a system limit; use the floating meter for a live reading.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1

versions.localizedDescription:
**New**

- Hold anywhere on the video to seek ([#116](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/116)). Press and hold on the picture, then drag sideways. The seek bar follows your finger and the video jumps where you let go, so you no longer have to hit the thin bar at the bottom. The taps you already know still work: the sides seek, the middle pauses.
- Search inside a channel ([#117](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/117)). Channel pages have a magnifier now, and whatever you type there searches that channel only. YouTube serves no filters for this kind of search, so there are none in the app either.
- Get a downloaded video out of the app ([#115](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/115)). The menu on a downloaded video has a new "Save to Files" row that hands the file to the usual iOS share sheet, so it can go to Files, Photos, AirDrop or another app. It is named after the video, and only the video leaves: subtitles, comments and the saved page stay where they were.
- Clear the whole search history at once ([#121](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/121)). The last row under Recent searches wipes the list, and it asks first.

**Fixes**

- The mini player no longer sits on top of the tab bar ([#118](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/118)). Tapping a tab behind the collapsed player switches to that tab instead of reopening the video.
- Stereo no longer gets spatialized on AirPods ([#119](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/119)). Ordinary two-channel sound was being turned into a fake surround field that moved when you turned your head. Video that really is multichannel still spatializes.
- The "..." menu stops closing on its own ([#128](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/128)). It was reacting to the device being tilted or put down, which made it look random when you held the phone in your hand.

**Also**

- If your device is older than Opaline supports, the README now points at [a downport for iOS 9](https://github.com/Joeviocoe/Opaline) by another developer, which runs on the iPad 2, iPad 3, iPad mini and iPhone 4S ([#125](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/125)).

apps.name: Orchard
apps.localizedDescription: Boots a real arm64 macOS Ventura guest on iPhone through Apple's own chain (AVPBooter, iBoot and XNU) on QEMU's apple-vm machine, with the GPU drawn through Metal by reims-vgpu. Requires JIT, a signing tool that adds the increased memory limit, and a macOS VM you make yourself. It is slow — light scenes reach 30–40 fps at best.

versions.localizedDescription:
Orchard for iPhone 0.2: a faster emulator and a faster Metal path, plus a fix for guests that end up in Recovery.

Setup and settings: [README](https://github.com/MakrSas/orchard-ios#readme).

## Faster

On an iPhone 15 (A16), light scenes now reach 30–40 frames a second. Dragging a window runs at 10–15 frames a second (in 0.1 it dropped to around 7 once the Dock and menu bar were up).

- **CPU (QEMU TCG)**
  - The jump cache is bigger and better hashed, and keeps each process's blocks across context switches. Block-lookup misses fell from ~15% to ~3%.
  - Changing ASID flushes only the user half of the TLB.
  - The PMU is off, and fewer system-register writes end a translation block or flush the TLB.
- **Fast pointer authentication** (on by default, in Settings → Machine → Processor). The guest still sees PAC, but no signature is computed. That was 10–15% of the emulator's time. Turn it off if macOS stops booting.
- **Metal path (reims-vgpu)**
  - A guest render pass stays on the GPU as one Metal pass, instead of a GPU round trip, a full-frame readback and a re-upload for every draw.
  - Draw buffers come from a shared ring.
  - Shader keys hash faster.
  - Stores write back only the drawn area, with a NEON channel swap straight into guest pages.
- **Tip:** 960×540 at 30 Hz is the sweet spot. In the guest, Reduce transparency helps dragging windows.

## Fixed

- **Guest stuck in Recovery with no disk.** This was macOS installing an automatic update, which cannot complete on this machine. Turn automatic updates off first thing; the README has the settings and the Terminal commands.
- **Disk safety.** The disk is flushed when the app goes to the background and on Shut Down, and the log records guest flushes and I/O errors.

## Also since 0.1

- Sound (experimental, Settings → Machine → Sound).
- A shared folder: Files → Orchard → Shared, mounted in the guest at `http://10.0.2.2:8080`.
- Internet in the guest works.

## You need

- iOS 16 or later, tested on an iPhone 15 with iOS 27, and a phone with 6 GB of memory or more.
- A signing tool that adds the increased memory limit capability, and JIT (such as StikDebug).
- A macOS 13 VM made in UTM on a Mac.

Unofficial, and not affiliated with Apple or ChefKiss. No Apple software is included. Licences: see LICENSE-NOTICE.md.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights

### 🌍 Roam Control in 10 Languages
Choose English, Hebrew, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Vietnamese, French, German or Spanish, or use System Default to select from the supported languages based on your iPhone's language preferences. Switch languages immediately, with right-to-left layout support for Hebrew and Arabic.

### 🗺️ Better Maps and Routes
Refined map controls, route handling and coordinate compatibility, with clearer handling when a route cannot be created.

### 🔄 Smarter Connection Recovery
Improved connection and location-session recovery when the app is allowed to run. iOS may suspend background apps, so unattended recovery cannot be guaranteed.

### 🚶 Your Speed, Your Route
Custom movement speeds for Walking, Cycling and Driving, refined driving targets and travel-time estimates, plus improvements to live walking-speed display.

### ✨ UI Refinements
A clearer language picker with native-language subtitles, improved recovery presentation and better handling of translated text throughout the app.

## What's New

### Localisation
- Eight new languages bring the total to ten, plus System Default.
- Language changes apply immediately without relaunching Roam Control.
- Arabic/Hebrew right-to-left layouts and isolation of PINs, versions and place names.
- Simplified/Traditional Chinese selection respects script and regional language preferences.
- Improved plural forms, multi-argument messages, system permissions text and interface sizing.

### Maps and Movement
- Refined map interaction and coordinate compatibility.
- Improvements to route handling and route-failure feedback.
- Custom Walking, Cycling and Driving movement-speed preferences.
- Better driving speed targets, route time estimates and walking-speed display.

### Connection Health and Recovery
- Improved reconnection and session-recovery behaviour while iOS allows background or foreground execution.
- Refined recovery controls and user guidance.

## Before You Install
- **iOS 27 or newer** and **Developer Mode** are required.

apps.name: SceneBox
apps.localizedDescription: Torrent streaming client for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS and Mac (Catalyst), written in SwiftUI. Streams come from Stremio-compatible addons and play through a vendored libtorrent engine feeding VLC.

versions.localizedDescription:
Important: accounts now need your own Firebase project

SceneBox no longer connects to a shared Firebase project. Sign-in, profiles and sync between devices now run on a free Firebase project that you create and own. Your data stays in your own account, not mine.

- Guest mode still works without any setup. Everything is kept on the device.
- To sign in, tap Connect Firebase on the sign-in screen and import the GoogleService-Info.plist from your Firebase project (on Apple TV, type in the values). Step-by-step guide and the security rules: https://github.com/donbytyqi/scenebox#firebase-setup
- Accounts made on the old shared project don't carry over. Create a new account on your own project.
- Profile photos need Firebase Storage, which requires Google's Blaze plan (it has a free tier). Everything else works on the free Spark plan.

New

- Support SceneBox page in Settings, for anyone who wants to donate.

Fixes

- Downloading a second episode from a season pack works now. Before, every episode of a pack counted as the same download, so you had to delete the finished one before the next would start. (#9)
- Apple TV: Trakt lists open when you click them. (#10)
- Mac: signing in works on the unsigned build. macOS doesn't let unsigned apps use the Keychain, so the app keeps your sign-in session and any API keys you enter in a file inside its own sandbox container instead (readable only by your user account).

Still open

- A few people report that on iPhone the app closes shortly after a stream starts buffering. I can't reproduce it on the simulator or on Mac. If it hits you, please share the crash log: Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements > Analytics Data, look for a file starting with SceneBox, and attach it to the issue. Also say which iPhone and what you were playing (torrent or debrid, resolution). 1.0.2 doesn't have this problem if you need a fallback.
- Apple TV install failing in Sideloadly with "ApplicationVerificationFailed / Invalid file" on tvOS 26.6 (#8). The tvOS build is packaged exactly like 1.0.2 and passes Apple's bundle verification here, so this needs the full Sideloadly log: the "Invalid file" line names the file it choked on. Please paste that on the issue. Sideloadly also has known trouble with tvOS 26.4 and later (pairing), so try the latest Sideloadly first.

Important: this release is NOT signed. You have to allow it yourself.

Nothing here is signed with an Apple developer account and the Mac app is not notarized. macOS and iOS will refuse to open it until you explicitly allow it. This is expected, it's not broken.

Mac:

1. Open the dmg and drag SceneBox to Applications.
2. Open SceneBox. macOS will say it "could not verify" the app or that it's from an unidentified developer. Press Done (not Move to Trash).
3. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security and press "Open Anyway" next to SceneBox, then confirm.
4. From then on it opens normally.

If you'd rather skip the dialog, run this in Terminal after copying the app to Applications:

    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/SceneBox.app

If you had an older signed version installed, delete it first.

iPhone/iPad: the ipa isn't signed, you sign it yourself with Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore, Feather or ESign with your own Apple ID. Free Apple ID = resign every 7 days (AltStore/SideStore do it for you), paid dev account = one year.

Apple TV: Sideloadly works over Wi-Fi. On the TV go to Settings > Remotes and Devices > Remote App and Devices so it shows up, then pick it in Sideloadly.

versions.localizedDescription:
A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

- Added **Per-category settings for sort and filters** to the Library, including changes made offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Added notifications when a new Tsumiru or server version is out, with **Remind later** and **Ignore** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Offset double spreads** to the paged reader for spreads that start on an odd page (@PainTownblue)

### ⚙️ Changes

- Made long strip taps and keys scroll by **Scroll distance** instead of a whole page (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed **Keep screen on** to off by default (@aaronbamblett)
- Added Up and Down page turns in horizontal paged mode and N and P to change chapter (@aaronbamblett)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Hid empty category tabs while searching or filtering the library, with **Show empty categories during search/filtering** to keep them (@aaronbamblett)
- Moved **Create registration code** to **Manage users** and added an **Edit** button to user rows (@aaronbamblett)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed the offline library not opening when Tsumiru starts without a connection (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Something went wrong** showing on every page while reading offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed library covers going blank in Safari after scrolling them off screen and back (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the paged reader restoring an old zoom when you return to a page (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed saved searches from older WebUI versions not loading (@aaronbamblett)

*Thanks to our Weblate translators: Damien O'Neil for French, Kisnov for Catalan, Andrei Stepanov for Russian and PainTownblue for Chinese.*

## Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See [Getting started](https://tsumiru.app/docs/guides/getting-started).

### Mobile

**Android:** download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

**iOS:** the `…-ios.ipa` below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add `https://tsumiru.app/apps.json` as a source in [SideStore](https://sidestore.io/) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io/) to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

- **[SideStore](https://sidestore.io/)** signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
- **[AltStore](https://altstore.io/)** expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
- **[TrollStore](https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-trollstore/)** installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

### Desktop

**Windows:** download `…-windows-x64.zip`, extract it anywhere, and run `tsumiru.exe`.

**macOS:** download `…-macos-universal.zip`, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

**Linux:** the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://flatpak.tsumiru.app/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru app.tsumiru.Tsumiru
```

Existing Flatpak installs keep receiving updates under `io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru`; no data, settings or logins move. AppImage/deb also keep that ID.

For a portable option, download `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### Web

Download `…-web.zip` and serve its contents with any static web server.

[Full documentation](https://tsumiru.app/)

UTM is a full featured virtual machine host for iOS. In short, it allows you to run Windows, Android, and more on your iPhone and iPad.

This version requires using AltJIT. Install UTM SE for slower emulation without JIT.

More information at https://getutm.app/

Features:

• Emulate any Processor
30+ processors supported by qemu including x86_64, ARM64, and RISC-V
• Run any Operating System
Windows, Linux, and more natively and securely on iOS within an App
• Fast Emulation
Para-virtualization with SPICE and JIT compilation with TCG
• High Compatibility
iOS 14+ supported. Works on iPhone and iPad. No jailbreak needed
• Free and Open Source
UTM and its dependencies are all free and open source
• Easy to Use
Configure and customize your VM in a native UI

versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (macOS) **Smoother displays**: VMs now follow your display's refresh rate, so motion is fluid at up to 120 Hz on ProMotion displays.
* **More reliable USB**: Fas

apps.name: VeneraNext
apps.localizedDescription: 基于 Flutter 的跨平台漫画阅读器，支持本地漫画、WebDAV 漫画源与第三方网络漫画源，支持 Android、iOS、Windows、Linux、macOS 平台。

versions.localizedDescription:
### 正式版与升级

- 发布正式版 `1.18.3+249`，集中交付收藏操作、目录导航、归档兼容和依赖解耦后的构建，运行时代码沿用已验收的 RC3。Android 手机／TV、Windows、macOS、iOS、Linux x64／ARM64 与鸿蒙从同一正式版提交重新构建；保留历史标签，不复用或重命名候选安装包。
- 稳定更新渠道推进至本版；AltStore 与 Winget 元数据依据实际公开安装包更新，Winget 公共源收录需等待 Microsoft 审核。iOS IPA 与鸿蒙 HAP 仍需自行签名侧载。
- 升级前导出并另存完整应用数据备份，保留原漫画文件。共享 WebDAV 数据的设备统一使用兼容版本；回退使用升级前的备份，不让旧版覆盖新版收藏库。覆盖升级保留原数据，无需清库或重新导入。

### 鸿蒙随版分发

- 正式版继续包含同版本的鸿蒙 ARM64 未签名测试版 HAP、`harmonyos-manifest.json`、`harmonyos-SHA256SUMS` 和中英文安装指南。应用源码与平台适配统一在 `main`；普通平台使用官方 Flutter 和根锁，鸿蒙使用独立固定 Flutter OH SDK、CPF 覆盖与受控锁模板。
- 鸿蒙应用为 `VeneraNext (HarmonyOS Beta)`，包名为 `com.github.cyrilpeng.veneranext.harmony`，最低／目标 SDK 为 API 26，版本为 `1.18.3`，构建号为 249。升级须沿用原签名身份／密钥，同一助手或账号不保证同一把密钥。
- 鸿蒙本地导入支持系统提供的目录选择、多选归档，以及带一层可选外部总目录的「漫画合集 ZIP」；结构有多本漫画／单本多章节歧义时由用户确认，取消不入库。目录仅复制导入，PDF 导入、系统分享及生物认证等限制见安装指南。
- 每次候选版与正式版均要求鸿蒙构建成功，准确源码、版本、原生库、资源和全部五项附件须通过生成资产、GitHub 草稿及公开资产核验；缺包或摘要不一致阻止整次发布。草稿按完整分页列表定位唯一标签，再按发布 ID 核验，发布源码与生成产物使用隔离目录。
- 鸿蒙继续标记未签名 Beta，manifest 保留 `signed: false` 和 `runtime_verified:

本次正式版在 v1.17.0 基础上完成大范围架构重构，收束阅读器、漫画源、同步与运行时的职责边界，并新增图片原始像素尺寸、章节阅读进度、自动阅读屏幕常亮与跳过不可用图片。同步修复 WebDAV 应用数据同步、日志持久化、AVIF 识别及图片去混淆性能问题，修复 Rust 依赖安全告警并更新相关依赖。经 v1.18.0-rc.1 至 rc.5 逐版验证，Windows 与 Android 的 WebDAV 手动上传、云端下载覆盖及自动同步已通过实机验收。

### 新增

- 阅读器可选显示图片原始像素尺寸，支持单页、多页、连续阅读及宽图拆分；缩小解码和缓存命中仍保留原始尺寸，开关支持全局／设备／单本设置（#95）。
- 收藏、追更及漫画卡片显示章节和页码进度，阅读时持久化章节／分组名称，图源不可用后仍可查看；旧历史兼容序号回退，长标题支持省略、完整提示和读屏（#93）。
- 自动阅读默认保持 Android／iOS 屏幕常亮，提供全局／设备／单本开关；停止自动阅读、切后台和退出时恢复系统休眠，旋转与迟到的原生回调不会遗留常亮状态（#96）。
- 自动阅读新增默认关闭的「跳过不可用图片」选项：失败图片按正常节奏跳过，加载中的图片在 1–60 秒可调的前台等待后继续；覆盖单页、并排页及连续／瀑布流视图，保留操作暂停和章节加载保护，修复瀑布流短错误占位在末章提前可见时的停止定位（#98 后续建议）。

### 修复

- 应用数据同步恢复 v1.17.0 的 WebDAV SDK 上传、下载及旧备份清理流程，沿用日期与数据版本文件名，不再要求条件 PUT、强 ETag 或内容基线；修复候选版上传已返回 201、却因下载／CDN 的 ETag 无法授权清理而持续报错并阻断后续同步的问题。
- 恢复 WebDAV 文件下载重定向兼容：仅允许 GET 受控跟随，跨源不传递 WebDAV 认证、Cookie、自定义请求头和默认查询参数，限制跳转次数并拒绝循环及 HTTPS 降级，恢复 123 云盘等服务的下载域名跳转。
- 修复 Android 数据目录经过系统路径别名时，同步初始化误报 `Upload data path contains a link`，以及备份已下载成功却在覆盖导入 `history.db` 等文件时报 `Import filesystem entry is an alias` 的问题；统一使用解析后的物理根目录，保留归档内部链接与越界检查。
- 修复阅读器横竖屏切换后自动阅读被中断的问题，旋转或每页图片数量变化时会清理失效的页面动画状态。
- 修复手动同步下载无法再次导入同版本备份的问题，支持确认后覆盖本地修改并强制导入远端归档。
- 修复 Hitomi 图片响应缺少可识别文件头时无法保存的问题，改用图片 URL 的扩展名作为安全回退。
- 信息、警告和错误日志按批次追加并刷新到磁盘，补写启动早期日志；重启保留记录，超过 2 MiB 时轮转到 `logs.previous.txt`，退出／导出等待写入完成，避免常驻文件句柄及未处理的写入异常（#88）。
- 修复 AVIF 的主品牌／兼容品牌和动画品牌识别，支持不同 ISO-BMFF 盒长度并拒绝截断或伪匹配；新增固定来源的测试样本与解码探测工具（#94）。
- 去混淆的独立像素缓冲区改为按行／连续块批量复制，保留共享缓冲区原有脚本语义；PNG 输出只读取有效子视图，返回 Dart 字节后立即释放原生缓冲区，避免额外复制及等待 GC，新增可复现的像素复制基准（#91）。
- 将纵向连续／瀑布流的边距设置明确标为「条漫缩小（每侧边距）」，补充平板使用说明、宽度比例表和 FAQ 入口；既有缩小功能保留当前阅读进度（#85）。
- 修复阅读、同步、图片下载及 CI 校验的其余问题，收束源操作、弹窗与收藏交互的原宿主归属。

### 维护与文档

- 发布版本更新为 `1.18.0+234`，同步应用版本、发布配置与更新记录。
- 定向升级 Rhttp 的 Rust 依赖，修复 10 条 GitHub 告警及全量扫描发现的 HTTP/2、QUIC 和内存安全问题；工具链更新至 1.92.0，补齐 Cargo 每周更新和完整锁文件审计，漏洞及 unsound 告警均阻断 CI（#101、#102、#103）。
- 更新 battery_plus、Dio、enough_convert、url_launcher 等 Dart 依赖及 Rhttp 常规依赖，保留 Flutter Rust Bridge 2.11.1 与本地取消回调补丁；将 libc 暂时固定为 0.2.189，并增加 PR 的 iOS Rhttp 原生编译门禁与依赖锁定回归检查。
- 在 WebDAV 同步关键代码块补充中文兼容性与安全约束注释，记录 123 云盘下载 302 回归原因、跨源凭据隔离、签名查询保留、404／ETag 判定及原生请求收尾要求。
- 更新中英文 README 与 Linux 分发说明的稳定版信息，补充数据同步、条漫缩小和依赖治理文档。
- 增加 Trendshift 项目徽章与 Dart 每日趋势排名徽章，并精简 README 目录与下载章节。

### 已知限制与后续安排

- 鸿蒙 HAP 支持（#77）、CBZ 分卷导出（#81）及图片请求 HTTP/3 回退（#100）留待后续版本；特定网络下部分图片 CDN 的 TCP／TLS 请求仍可能失败。
- AVIF 格式识别改进不代表所有平台均已具备完整的通用／动画解码能力；通用内置解码器仍待接入（#94）。
- 图片去混淆的移动端耗电收益仍需实机测量。

### 运行说明

- 升级前请导出本地数据备份，再覆盖安装新版；同步复用原有同步配置、数据库和恢复记录，无需清空应用数据或重建 WebDAV 账号。
- 应用数据同步沿用 v1.17.0 协议，多设备同时编辑不会合并，也不提供条件写入／删除的并发保护；请避免在多台设备上同时修改同一份数据后立即同步。
- Linux AppImage 需要 glibc 2.35 或更新版本、兼容的 OpenGL／EGL 驱动，以及可写、可执行且留有约 100 MB 空间的 `/tmp`。

apps.name: TrollInstallerX
apps.localizedDescription:
Overview

TrollInstallerX is a universal TrollStore installer. It focuses on being extremely reliable and easy to use. It is also very fast, being able to install TrollStore and/or its persistence helper in a matter of seconds on the latest devices.

TrollInstallerX supports all devices running iOS 14.0 - 16.6.1, both arm64 and arm64e. It makes use of one of two different methods to install TrollStore, depending on what device and iOS you have. These methods are:

• Direct installation: using the kfd kernel exploit, along with the dmaFail PPL bypass on iOS 15.2+ arm64e devices, TrollInstallerX can install both TrollStore and its persistence helper directly onto the device without having to leave the installer.

   - Supports iOS 14.0 - 16.6.1 (arm64) and iOS 14.0 - 16.5.1 (arm64e).
      • Note: A15, A16, and M2 devices on iOS 16.5.1 do not support this method.
      • Note: A8 devices are only supported on iOS 14.0 - 15.1 for the time being.
• Indirect installation: Using the kfd kernel exploit, TrollInstallerX can replace a system application of your choice with the TrollStore persistence helper. This method only exists due to both the lack of a PPL bypass on iOS 16.6 and above, as well as the fact that dmaFail is non-functional on A15, A16, and M2 devices on iOS 16.5.1.

   - Supports iOS 16.5.1 - 16.6.1 (arm64e).
      • Note: This method is the only method that supports A15, A16, and M2 devices on iOS 16.5.1.

Both methods allow you to install a persistence helper into a removable system app. The reason that this is needed is due to the way that the CoreTrust bug (used by TrollStore) works - in certain circumstances, TrollStore and other apps installed by it will be reset to User registration, instead of System. You cannot open any of these apps until you have used the persistence helper to set them back to System registration.


Usage

TrollInstallerX is extremely easy to use. Simply download the latest release from the Releases page, and sideload it using your preferred method. Once installed, open the app and press the "Install" button. From there, TrollStore and/or its persistence helper will be installed onto your device.

TrollInstallerX will automatically choose the best exploit for your device. However, in some cases, you may want to choose a specific exploit. To do this, simply open the settings view and select the exploit that you want to use. Once you have selected it, press the "Install TrollStore" button and TrollInstallerX will use the exploit you have chosen.

Note: iOS 16.2 - 16.6.1 and iOS 15.7.2 - 15.8.2 require an internet connection in order for TrollInstallerX to download the kernelcache and patchfind it.

apps.name: PPSSPP
apps.localizedDescription:
PPSSPP is the best and only PSP emulator for iOS written in C++. It is capable of running a lot of original games but, depending on the power of your device, not all may run at full speed due to restrictions on non-jailbroken devices.

The app was originally created by Henrik Rydgård in November 2012; however, iOS builds are mostly managed by talented developer, Karen Tsai (aka @angelxwind) and a large group of contributors that submit issue reports and fixes. Several versions of PPSSPP can be played on numerous devices such as Android, Windows, Mac, Linux and Blackberry 10. The iOS version can be found on both Jailbreak and non-Jailbreak devices.

PPSSPP supports all versions of iPad, iPhone, iPod touch running iOS 5 and above; this includes iPhone 5 and other retina-enabled devices. The emulator does not require bios to play, PPSSPP is - in many ways - a “HLE” emulator. PPSSPP requires ROM images, specifically .ISO or .CSO files, to play. No ROMs are included in this copy of the emulator. If you own any games, add them through iTunes Sharing or other programs like 'iExplorer.' Keep in mind these files are extremely big, sometimes taking several gigs in size.

The emulator is built to use JIT decompilers (dynarecs) which can only be accessed on a jailbroken device due to the codesigining requirement. Therefore, most games will run very slow on non-jailbroken devices; however, there are a few older PSP games that will run just fine and up to speed depending on your iOS device.

apps.name: Henge
apps.localizedDescription: Henge runs macOS on iPhone and iPad with its own emulator. It downloads Apple's restore image and installs macOS right on the device, no Mac needed. Safari and Discord run, and the clipboard and a shared folder work between macOS and the device. It's emulation, so it runs slower than a real Mac. Henge needs JIT (StikDebug, its built-in StikJIT on iOS 26 or later, TrollStore or a jailbreak), iOS 17 or later, an A14 or M1 chip or newer, and about 43 GB free.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's new?
- macOS Sonoma 14.6.1 and Ventura 13.6 in the Install tab: smaller downloads (14.1 and 12.3 GB) for devices short on storage
- Sonoma's and Ventura's graphics drivers work with Henge, including Sonoma's moving wallpaper and video, without green bands
- A light theme: Settings › Appearance picks System, Light or Dark (the session stays dark while a Mac runs)
- The screen is a Magic Trackpad 2 to the Mac: macOS's own gestures, tap and hold clicks, and optional volume-button clicks (#54)
- macOS downloads go on after Henge is closed or killed, and a trash button deletes a downloaded or partial one
- macOS shuts down and restarts properly, and a Mac can start again without reopening Henge (#50)
- Installs: a 10 GB Mac no longer runs the phone out of memory two thirds of the way through, the restore streams its ramdisk instead of holding two copies (#39), a second tap can't start a duplicate install (#61), and a Mac finished while the phone locked is still listed
- JIT: tapping Turn On JIT while it's already turning on no longer leaves a second helper attached (that made the Mac 1.5-2x slower), JIT is prepared when StikDebug attaches a moment after opening Henge (#46), and the helper finds the pairing port itself when iOS reports none (#52)
- Speed work on how the emulator handles macOS's TLB flushes and code changes, and a 1.5 GB code cache by default where the memory limit allows
- Lighter macOS (session Details): types a Terminal command that turns off window and Dock animations, widgets, the screen saver and a moving wallpaper; plus a 30 Hz refresh option and Game Mode
- macOS starts with its clock at zero, as on a real Mac, instead of thinking it has been running (and idle) for days
- Web lookups go through the device's own DNS (#34)
- Right-click works (a Control-click, #33), and a physical mouse's right and middle buttons can be swapped (#63)
- The firmware disk reports its real size and takes large transfers (#31)
- Henge has its own AltStore/SideStore source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Leviidev/Henge/main/repo.json

## Confirmed Working
macOS Sonoma 14.6.1 - installs and runs on an iPhone 17 Pro
macOS Ventura 13.6 - installs, logs in and browses on an iPhone 17 Pro
macOS Tahoe 26.6.2 - installs and sets up on an iPhone 17 Pro
macOS 27.2 and Sequoia 15.6.1, as in 0.2

## Known issues
- Monterey isn't offered: it installs, but its desktop never appears.
- Sonoma: choosing the dynamic "Sonoma" wallpaper can stop the screen updating; opening any app brings it back.
- Ventura: the Calendar icon in the Dock is missing its date.
- Emulation is still slow, mostly at login and on macOS 27.
- iOS and iPadOS 17: the screen stays black after the Apple logo (#44). A fix is proposed in #94.
- Safari's pages may stay blank on macOS 27 (not re-checked since 0.2).

The local installation CA was replaced to remove personal metadata. If you use OTA installation, install and trust the new certificate from Settings after updating.

The release contains an unsigned iOS IPA and a macOS ZIP without a personal development team.

versions.localizedDescription:
### 新增

- 封面展开成详情页时改用新的缩放转场：卡片按自身圆角连续变形，展开与收回与 Apple TV App 的转场观感一致；追番页的收藏状态角标改为独立响应，点它不会再连带打开详情页
- 观看历史在宽屏（可用宽度 ≥ 700）改为两到三列网格，与时间表页的排布一致

### 修复

- 修复 iPhone Duo 展开时推荐页横向海报货架溢出到右侧竖栏下面的问题
- 修复 Duo 从全屏播放退出后再展开，界面仍被钉在竖向无法跟随设备旋转的问题
- 修复手机横屏等矮屏下追番页与更多列表的封面被撑得比竖屏大近一倍的问题，改为按更小的步长分列

### 优化

- 时间表在横屏按窗口左右安全区计算页宽，翻页后不再露出下一天的一角
- 更多列表页的卡片标题对齐追番页：12pt 常规字重、两行、行距 3.6、与海报顶部留 6pt，字号变化时高度跟着缩放
- 从详情页返回推荐页时不再重读磁盘缓存并覆写列表，避免整页与所有卡片重新排版
- 更多列表去掉右下角回顶悬浮按钮，恢复普通滚动；底部留白相应收紧

### 新增

- 一起看（Syncplay）：按标准 Syncplay 协议与其他客户端同房间同步播放，播放、暂停、拖动进度会自动对齐，支持房间口令与 TLS，顶栏显示实时延迟，可查看房间成员。服务器地址、房间、昵称和口令会记住并纳入设置备份
- 下载剧集时顺带保存该集弹幕，离线或飞行模式下播放也能直接显示；在本地已有弹幕文件时优先读本地，不再等网络

### 修复

- 修复应用覆盖安装或用侧载工具重签后，沙盒目录变化导致已下载剧集打不开、下载记录失效的问题（[#39](https://github.com/LinkPass888/Kazumi-Swift/issues/39)）：现在按相对路径重新定位本地文件，旧记录里的失效路径也能找回
- 修复下载剧集后在线选集列表加载不出来的问题
- 修复弹幕设置里点「关键词屏蔽」会中断播放并退回上一页的问题；屏蔽按字面量和 `/正则/` 实时生效
- 修复播放时屏幕不按设定常亮、跟随系统锁定时间熄屏的问题
- 修复规则镜像设置的键名不一致，导致每次冷启动被重置的问题
- 补齐设置备份遗漏的弹幕样式、硬解与低内存策略、AniSkip、Syncplay 等设置，恢复后立即生效，不需要重启
- 修复通过 `kazumi://` 规则链接打开应用时不会弹出导入框的问题

### 优化

- 从播放页正常返回详情页时不再多叠一层选源面板；只有起播失败后才自动重开选源
- 打开弹幕设置面板时自动暂停，关闭后自动续播
- 全屏横屏时弹幕设置按钮移到弹幕开关右侧，方便双手横持
- 弹幕请求与视频解析并行，画面出来时弹幕已就绪；同一部番换集不再反复解析弹幕源
- 追番页封面按可视区并发加载，加载完统一刷新，不再整格网格反复重绘；Bangumi 批量同步合并后一次落盘，避免主线程卡死
- 播放器菜单探测与定时关闭改成状态驱动，取消每秒重绘；播放进度改为防抖写入
- WebDAV 同步在云盘内容无变化时跳过上传；DLNA 投屏先探测上次用过的设备，能更快出列表
- 设置页在 iPad 与 Mac 宽屏下二级页面统一限宽居中；日志页增加「全部」分类与文本过滤
- 清理无引用的旧同步代码，播放页拆分成多个模块

### 新增

- 下载管理器新增「全部开始 / 全部暂停」全局控制按钮（[#37](https://github.com/LinkPass888/Kazumi-Swift/issues/37)）
- 宽屏设备横屏播放时采用左右双栏布局：左侧播放器+简介，右侧选集与评论标签页完整可见；线路 / 缓存操作栏移至右侧标签页上方，缓存按钮与集数更近（[#34](https://github.com/LinkPass888/Kazumi-Swift/issues/34)）
- 播放页底部选集 / 简介区支持侧滑返回

### 修复

- 修复 MP4 直链下载进度条一直显示 0%、断点续传失败的问题（[#35](https://github.com/LinkPass888/Kazumi-Swift/issues/35)）

### 优化

- 全屏播放器顶底栏安全区视觉留白对齐；跳过片头按钮与 HUD 气泡尺寸微调

### 安装

下载 `MoviePilot-1.2.6-unsigned.ipa` 后自行重签。本包没有 Apple 证书签名，不能直接安装；原生推送需要开发者团队为 `com.moviepilot.app` 启用 Push Notifications，并使用带该权限的生产描述文件，同时重签小组件、保留一致的 App Groups。免费账户须在重签时移除 `aps-environment`，继续使用主屏幕网页通知。

如果旧版使用 `org.moviepilot.app`，新版会作为独立 App 安装，需要重新登录及绑定通知；旧 App 和数据不会自动迁移或删除。重签后 Bundle ID 与已有安装一致时才能覆盖更新，原生推送还须与 Server 的 topics 允许名单一致。

## WQGuard v1.3.6 (Build 27)

### Highlights / 更新摘要

#### 1. Engine 2 Real-World IPA ZIP Compatibility Fix (Issue #2)
Resolved two real-world IPA scanning failures reported in [Issue #2](https://github.com/Kianuni/WQGuard/issues/2) while keeping strict archive integrity and anti-tampering checks enforced:
- **Streaming `GPFlag` bit-3 (`0x0008`) without trailing Data Descriptor**: App Store / IPA repackagers frequently keep bit 3 set in Local File Headers even after populating Central Directory sizes and CRCs without emitting a trailing Data Descriptor (`descLen == 0`). `NativeZIPArchiveReader` now supports `descLen == 0` alongside 12/16/20/24-byte descriptors while continuing to reject contradictory non-zero Local Header bit-3 fields (`corruptHeader`).
- **Deflated empty directories & NUL alignment padding**: Added support for `method == 8` empty directory entries (`uncompSize == 0`, `compSize <= 16`) and up to 64 KB of `0x00` alignment padding between entries.
- **Uncompacted `.appex`
