apps.localizedDescription:
Deltroid is an all-in-one emulator for iOS. Deltroid builds upon the strengths of its predecessor Delta while improving on it in a community supported fashion. 

Github Repository (https://github.com/lonkelle/Deltroid) 

FEATURES

Supported Game Systems
• Nintendo Entertainment System
• Super Nintendo Entertainment System
• Nintendo 64
• Game Boy (Color)
• Game Boy Advance
• Nintendo DS
• Nintendo DSi
• Sega Genesis
• And plenty more to come!

Controller Support
• Supports PS4, PS5, Xbox One S, Xbox Series X, and MFi game controllers.
• Supports bluetooth (and wired) keyboards, as well as the Apple Smart Keyboard.
• Completely customize button mappings on a per-system, per-controller basis.
• Map buttons to special “Quick Save”, “Quick Load,” and “Fast Forward” actions.

Save States
• Save and load save states for any game from the pause menu.
• Lock save states to prevent them from being accidentally overwritten.
• Automatically makes backup save states to ensure you never lose your progress.
• Support for “Quick Saves,” save states that can be quickly saved/loaded with a single button press (requires external controller).

Cheats
• Supports various types of cheat codes for each supported system:
• NES: Game Genie
• SNES: Game Genie, Pro Action Replay
• N64: GameShark
• GBC: Game Genie, GameShark
• GBA: Action Replay, Code Breaker, GameShark
• DS: Action Replay

Deltroid Sync
• Sync your games, game saves, save states, cheats, controller skins, and controller mappings between devices.
• View version histories of everything you sync and optionally restore them to earlier versions.
• Supports both Google Drive and Dropbox.

Custom Controller Skins
• Beautiful built-in controller skins for all systems.
• Import controller skins made by others, or even make your own to share with the world!

Hold Button
• Choose buttons for Delta to hold down on your behalf, freeing up your thumbs to press other buttons instead.
• Perfect for games that typically require one button be held down constantly (ex: run button in Mario games, or the A button in Mario Kart).

Fast Forward
• Speed through slower parts of games by running the game much faster than normal.
• Easily enable or disable from the pause menu, or optionally with a mapped button on an external controller.

3D/Haptic Touch
• Use 3D or Haptic Touch to “peek” at games, save states, and cheat codes.
• App icon shortcuts allow quick access to your most recently played games, or optionally customize the shortcuts to always include certain games.

Game Artwork
• Automatically displays appropriate box art for imported games.
• Change a game’s artwork to anything you want, or select from the built-in game artwork database.

Misc.
• Gyroscope support (WarioWare: Twisted! only)
• Microphone support (DS only)
• Support for delta:// URL scheme to jump directly into a specific game.

apps.name: GBA4iOS
apps.subtitle: Game Boy games in your pocket.
apps.localizedDescription:
Classic Gaming, Meet iOS.

While iPhone and iOS have brought a new era of gaming upon us, there will always be room in our hearts for those classic games from decades ago. Unfortunately, there has been no easy way for people to play these games whenever they so desired...that is, until now. GBA4iOS was made for one purpose and one purpose only: to help everyone relive their favorite games from their past. Now, every where you take your iPhone, iPad, or iPod Touch, you can bring and play your classic games with you, giving you practically endless hours of entertainment!

So that's great and all, but what features does GBA4iOS actually have? Far too many to list in one App Store description, but here are some of the biggest:

• Multiplayer (iPhone 5 or newer, iPad 4 or newer). GBA4iOS allows you to link with other players nearby and play with them, allowing you to unlock or experience certain events in games that are unavailable to just one player! Plus, nothing is cooler than playing games with your friends.

• Save States. Ever get frustrated when a game requires you to save only at certain points? Well be frustrated no longer, GBA4iOS fully supports Save States, allowing you to save anywhere in the game and resume right from that point later. Even better, you can protect certain save states so you never accidentally overwrite them (and as everyone knows losing game data is one of the worst things in the world).

• Cheat Codes. Sometimes games are just too hard, and you need a little boost to help defeat it. GBA4iOS allows you to input and use GameShark, Action Replay, Code Breaker, and Game Genie codes as you see fit. Don't worry, we won't judge!

• Fast Forward (iPhone 4s or newer, iPad 2 or newer, iPod Touch 5th Gen). Don't you wish there was a way to speed up long cutscenes in games, or to reduce the time doing boring tasks in the game? Well, now there is! GBA4iOS allows you to "Fast Forward" through slow parts of the game, allowing you to get back to the fun even quicker.

• Customizable Controller Skins. Want to change the look of the controller to something more personal? No worries, you can download a multitude of new controller skins from within the app, or download almost countless more from the web! You'll definitely be able to find a controller skin you like.

• Dropbox Sync. Have multiple devices, or worried something will happen to your games? Dropbox Sync solves both these issues! When enabled, GBA4iOS will sync your game saves, save states, and cheat codes to Dropbox, keeping any and all your devices up to date with your latest changes. Plus, this means your game data is always backed up in the cloud, so if something happens to your device, your data is safe.

• MFi Controller Support. Sometimes, touchscreen buttons just aren't good enough for the level of precision needed by some games. Luckily, GBA4iOS supports MFi Controllers, allowing you to connect and use physical controllers with your games! Now you can beat that final boss without a sweat.

All this and more ensures that GBA4iOS will give you the best portable gaming experience, hands down. So what are you waiting for, download GBA4iOS now and enjoy reliving your favorite classic games immediately!

apps.localizedDescription:
Play classic DOS games on your iPhone and iPad!

iDOS turns your device right into a powerful DOS gaming PC, with modern game control to make your old favorites as playable as possible.

You can also use iDOS for non-gaming purposes, such as word processing, casual programming. Apps in the DOS days are often simpler and surprisingly productive.

KEYBOARD

iDOS provides a PC compatible on-screen keyboard with carefully designed layouts for different devices and orientations. The keyboard has a sliding control in landscape mode so that you can keep it from covering critical part of the screen.

Bluetooth keyboard is partially supported. We support ESC, function keys, and ordinary CTRL and ALT key bindings. Unfortunately the arrow keys can't be used for game control. You should use a bluetooth game controller instead.

GAMEPAD

iDOS provides a virtual gamepad with key bindings that are fairly common in DOS games. You can customize the bindings. The DPAD works in 8-axis way. It can also be toggled into a joystick.

External bluetooth game controllers are supported. Make sure your game controller is connected (System Settings->Bluetooth). To customize button bindings, go to iDOS in landscape mode, tap on bluetooth icon on the auto-hiding top bar.

MOUSE

* The screen area serves as a trackpad for moving mouse pointer.
* Tap on the screen for left click. If direct touch is enabled, the mouse pointer will move to where you tap.
* Hold one finger on the screen, and tap with another finger for right click.
* On-screen mouse buttons are also provided for your convenience.
* Bluetooth mice are only partially supported.

SUPPORT

- Visit https://litchie.com/dospad for more information.
- Send email to idos@litchie.com
- Follow the developer on Twitter: https://twitter.com/litchiedev
- iDOS is open source, report issues on https://github.com/litchie/dospad

apps.name: MAME4iOS
apps.subtitle: A MAME Arcade emulator for iOS.
apps.localizedDescription:
MAME stands for Multi Arcade Machine Emulator. This app lets you play arcade games from the past 30+ years on your iPhone, iPad, macOS, or AppleTV.

More than 2000 games are supported, and the currently supported romset version is MAME 0.139u1 (September 2010).

Other nifty features include:
* 64-bit binary to run on modern and future iOS devices
* Supports modern device screen sizes, including iPhone X/XR/XS/XS Max and iPad Pro
* A native iOS/iPadOS/tvOS frontend (by @ToddLa, new in 2020!)
* A native Metal rendering engine (by @ToddLa, new in 2020!)
* tvOS support (new in 2019!)
* An in-app web server to transfer files from your computer (new in 2019!)
* Transfer ROMs, Artwork, and ROMSETs via AirDrop or iOS File Sharing (new in 2020!)
* Multiple MFI controllers (up to 4 with dual analog support - @DarrenBranford)
* Supports using the touch screen as a lightgun
* Turbo mode toggle for buttons
* Touch analog for games like Arkanoid
* Builds in Xcode 11.x/12.x and runs on latest iOS 13/14 versions

apps.name: Ready
apps.subtitle: 8-bit games for your iPad.
apps.localizedDescription:
Ready is an open source emulator for the following 8 bit home computers:
* Commodore 64
* Commodore VIC-20
* Commodore 16, Plus/4
* Sinclair ZX Spectrum (16k, 48k, Spectrum+, 128k, +2)

With preliminary support for these computers:
* Atari 600XL, 800XL
* Commodore 128
* Commander X16

It is based on atari800, fuse, Vice, and x16-emulator, which provide accurate emulation of many hardware variants and peripherals. Ready requires at least iPadOS 13.5.

Ready aims to approximate the feeling of using actual hardware. Rather than configuring abstract settings, you select hardware components. The software keyboard is a facsimile of the original, reflecting the different existing styles. Even the noise of the disk drive is emulated. The Library section offers a way to organize a large collection of games, demos and programs. The emulated hardware can be customized for each entry.

The Inbox provides a place to quickly try new programs. You can easily move the ones you want to keep to the library.

Tools mode allows attaching a cartridge like Action Replay or Final Cartridge and a collection of disks with your favorite tools, to help you dig into the programs, like back in the day.

apps.name: RetroArch
apps.subtitle: Cross-platform, sophisticated frontend for emulation.
apps.localizedDescription:
RetroArch is a frontend for a plethora of emulators. Almost every Retro console can be run using one of RetroArch's downloadable cores.

There are several ways to customize your experience by installing different themes, rearranging your touchscreen controls, and downloading game box art.
RetroArch enables you to run classic games on a wide range of computers and consoles through its slick graphical interface. Settings are also unified so configuration is done once and for all.

In addition to this, you will soon be able to run original game discs (CDs) from RetroArch.

RetroArch has advanced features like shaders, netplay, rewinding, next-frame response times, runahead, machine translation, blind accessibility features, and more!

Check out all of RetroArch's awesome features at our website: https://www.retroarch.com/

apps.name: ScummVM
apps.subtitle: Point and click adventures.
apps.localizedDescription:
ScummVM is a program which allows you to run certain classic graphical point-and-click adventure games and role-playing games, provided you already have their data files. The clever part about this: ScummVM just replaces the executables shipped with the games, allowing you to play them on systems for which they were never designed!

ScummVM supports a huge library of adventures with over 250 games in total. It supports many classics published by legendary studios like LucasArts, Sierra On-Line, Revolution Software, Cyan, Inc. and Westwood Studios. Next to ground-breaking titles like the Monkey Island series, Broken Sword, Myst, Blade Runner and countless other games you will find some really obscure adventures and truly hidden gems to explore.

apps.subtitle: Virtual machines for iOS (without JIT support)
apps.localizedDescription:
UTM is a full featured virtual machine host for iOS. In short, it allows you to run Windows, Android, and more on your iPhone and iPad.
This version runs on all > iOS 11 devices but lacks JIT support and is slower than regular UTM.


More information at https://getutm.app/

Features:

• Emulate any Processor
30+ processors supported by qemu including x86_64, ARM64, and RISC-V
• Run any Operating System
Windows, Linux, and more natively and securely on iOS within an App
• Fast Emulation
Para-virtualization with SPICE and JIT compilation with TCG
• High Compatibility
iOS 11+ supported. Works on iPhone and iPad. No jailbreak needed
• Free and Open Source
UTM and its dependencies are all free and open source
• Easy to Use
Configure and customize your VM in a native UI


Note: Screenshots are from the updated interface only available on iOS 14.

# Cloudn 1.4.2

这一版新增 SideStore / AltStore 侧载软件源支持，修复 Instagram 网页登录点「完成」卡住的问题，并带来多项稳定性、解析与性能优化。

## 新增与改进

- **SideStore / AltStore 软件源**：新增 [altstore.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengangs/Cloudn/main/altstore.json) 订阅源并在发版时自动更新；在「设置 › 更新 › 添加侧载软件源」中可一键添加到 SideStore / AltStore 或复制源地址。
- **Instagram 网页登录修复**：支持从 `sessionid` 提取用户 ID 并补全 `ds_user_id`，实时合并页面 `document.cookie`，放宽非登录页重定向时的校验误判，并在未检测到登录态或校验失败时弹出明确提示。
- **并发与稳定性优化**：加强下载与解析任务防重入保护、完善各网盘/视频解析器与分享扩展边界处理，提升列表滚动、实时活动与无障碍体验。

## 安装

推荐通过 SideStore / AltStore 订阅本仓库软件源直接接收更新；也可下载下方附件里的 `Cloudn-v1.4.2.ipa` 自行签名后安装（需要 iOS 17 及以上）。

versions.localizedDescription:
## 已知问题

- **切歌无声 / 上一首残留问题仍存在**：本版已尝试根治（原生层播放/暂停去早退、切歌意图确立后立即静音旧源、挂起后死亡播放器自愈），真机实测概率性仍可复现——后续版本继续排查

## 上游 6.2.0 移植

- 版本号与上游对齐（6.2.0+53），全量同步上游 md3Music 6.2.0：播放链路重构（本地 API 服务器新增响度参数与预热、媒体会话收敛）、依赖更新（m3_expressive、ort_dart、image、sqflite_common_ffi 等）、桌面小组件服务调整与全部上游修复
- just_audio 播放内核同步至上游版本，iOS fork 补丁（音频焦点中断转发、均衡器挂载、辅助播放器）全部保留并适配新接口

## iOS 修复

- **iOS 26 桌面小组件按钮全部无响应修复**：iOS 26 弃用了在 extension 中设置 `openAppWhenRun` 的行为（点击 intent 根本不执行）；按钮 intent 改为双 target 共享 + 新 `supportedModes` 属性。播放控制类按钮（播放/暂停、上下曲、FM 控制等）现走系统后台执行协议——**点组件直接切歌，不再跳转打开 app**
- **短暂挂起回前台后播放不了修复**：挂起会触发系统媒体服务重置，播放器实例死亡但应用状态未更新，点播放走快路径无声无错。新增前台死亡观察：播放中但进度 10 秒不动的判定为死播放器，自动重建并恢复到原进度（锁屏/切后台几分钟后回来自动恢复）
- **挂起恢复后搜索/解析全部失败修复**：挂起后本地 API 服务器工作线程死亡而监听端口残留，旧探测方式被内核代答误判「服务正常」且永不自愈；探测改为真实 HTTP 请求，回前台主动健康检查并按需重建服务
- **3D 封面系列修复**：iOS 缓存目录异常曾导致推理链路完全静默失败（不推理也无提示），失败原因现已对用户可见；脏缓存条目（索引在、文件丢）被误判为「设备不支持 shader」导致全进程降级多层视差的问题修复——缓存命中增加完整性校验，缺失自动重新推理
- **歌词画中画修复**：双行布局在较大字号下上下顶边裁切（行距超界），改为按剩余空间三等分居中——任何字号、单双行都完整居中
- **显示大小**：调整后未点「保留」就杀后

## 谢谢大家
谢谢每一位在玩、在报 bug、在评论区出主意的朋友，是大家的支持让这个重制版一路更新到现在。

这个重制版一开始只是我用公司给的无限 token，自己做着自己玩的；没想到承蒙大家喜爱，被大家无私地越传越广。**这个游戏属于每一位喜欢大富翁4的玩家：永远不收任何费用，也不做任何商业用途，大家尽管拿去玩就好。**

**1.3 的新地图正在制作中**，工作量比较大，下一个版本要隔比较长的一段时间才会发布。这段时间里，1.2.4 就是大家的主力版本：

- **遇到 bug 或小问题**：可以直接在 [Issues](https://github.com/iam567/rich4-renew-app/issues) 提交，也可以在 B 站 UP 主 **TrustBox**、**阿姆西_MC** 发布的大富翁4 重制版视频下面留言。各个评论区我都会看，能修的一定会修。
- **在线更新很慢或失败**：这个我暂时没办法解决。在国内提供下载需要办理备案，我个人没办法申请，所以国内的朋友在线更新时请先开代理；或者直接下载这个页面的安装包覆盖安装，效果一样，存档也会保留。

再次感谢大家，我们 1.3 见！

> **1.2.4 是 1.2 之后几个小版本的合集，这次最大的新功能是「排行榜」。** 已经装了 1.2.x 的玩家，在游戏里在线更新就能升到 1.2.4，不用重新下载；新玩家、或者在线更新一直不成功的，直接下载下面的安装包覆盖安装就行，存档、设置都会保留（保险起见，可以先在「游戏设置 → 存档备份」导出一份）。

## v1.2.4 更新内容

- **新增：排行榜。** 标题画面「图鉴」下面多了「排行榜」按钮：
  - 四个榜：最富榜（通关时资产最多）、最快榜（通关用时最短）、最狠榜、最惨榜；每张地图、每个难度各自排名，显示前 50 名，自己的最好成绩固定在最下面。
  - 「开始游戏」里 1 个玩家打 3 个电脑、让所有电脑破产，就可能上榜。打进前 50 名会跳出「新纪录」：填名字，选地区（各省、香港、澳门、台湾，海外可以再选国家），还可以留一个社交账号（抖音、B站、YouTube 等，最多 16 个字），显示在排行榜上让大家来找你挑战。上榜后名字、地区和账号都不能再修改。
  - 最狠榜和最惨榜怎么算分，排行榜里按「怎么算分」可以看。
  - 为了

# Simple Live v1.13.3 更新速览

发布日期：2026-10-25

本版主题：发热优化、Windows 退出修复、桌面端快捷键中文输入法适配、B站弹幕缺失修复与虎牙 4K 断流调查结论。2026-11-01 追加全屏四角时钟（#160），2026-11-02 追加音量增强与音量手势修复（#161），2026-11-03 修复抖音部分房间登录墙导致进不去、关注页刷不出，2026-11-08 追加 iOS 系统画中画、取消关注不再触发全量刷新（#163）与 WebDAV 恢复 500 根因修复（#164）。

经过19次构建，终于解决了，连media_kit都没解决的iOS PIP问题，在一个PR中，获得了思路，经过一些修复，与我们项目实现了兼容。

在此，感谢各位提供日志的用户：@laobai95 等等多位用户（请在群内提供git用户名）。
## 省电模式（新增，默认关闭）

- 针对安卓端观看时发热严重的反馈，新增一键「省电模式」（设置 → 直播间设置 → 播放器，置于首位）：视频缩放降档（均衡 → bilinear、画质 → spline36）、弹幕限 60 帧、关闭弹幕描边、放宽安卓播放检测频率、多开上限 4 个且压至最低清晰度。
- 默认关闭，关闭时所有行为与 v1.13.2 完全一致；打开后进入下一个直播间生效。全端开关一致可见（iOS 上为弹幕部分生效）。

## 弹幕渲染降耗

- 弹幕描边开关（默认开）：关闭后每条弹幕少一次整段文本绘制，弹幕越密越省。
- 帧率上限（默认跟随屏幕）：高刷屏可限 60 帧，视觉无差异、GPU 负担约减半。
- 修复「描边宽度」设置从未生效的问题（渲染侧此前硬编码为 2）。
- 弹幕层透明度改为逐条并入颜色 alpha，去掉整层离屏合成（视觉不变）。

## 性能与修复

- 高热房间 CPU：屏蔽词正则从「每条消息每个词重新编译」改为编译一次缓存，消息量越大收益越明显。
- Windows 退出修复：关闭应用时偶发的「快速异常检测失败」fast-fail 弹窗与进程挂死；本地 fork media_kit_video Windows 部分，纹理与 mpv render context 释放改为同步等待，退出时等待 mpv 关停。
- 关闭窗口弹「Unknown Hard Error」：装有搜狗输入法

apps.name: WQManager
apps.subtitle: 无需越狱的 App 数据备份与缓存清理工具
apps.localizedDescription: 一款面向 iOS 26+ 的开源 App 数据管理、备份与单应用缓存清理工具，无需越狱。可把某个 App 的数据目录打包成可校验的备份并写回原 App，也能只清理所选 App 的缓存与临时目录。所有数据都在本机处理，没有账号、没有统计、没有云端。

versions.localizedDescription:
显示版本 **0.5**，构建 **1**；内部发布修订 **0.5.0**。

这个版本的主题是「找得到、看得懂、拿得走」：

- **全局文件搜索**：跨 App 搜索用户文件，结果边扫边出；支持文件名 / 相对路径 / App 名、类型与最小大小筛选、路径 / 大小 / 最新排序。结果可原地预览或打开所在目录，扫描中可取消。
- **空间变化**：按「较上次 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天」比较，按增长排序并显示合计占用与净变化；新增全部 App 合计趋势图，单 App 详情保留当前大小、较上次、近 7 天与扫描历史。
- **文件审计与导出**：大文件 / 重复文件按 App 分组，重复项经 SHA-256 确认；清理时每个 App 至少保留一份，删除进入空间透镜回收站。导出中心可分享或存储到「文件」，目标写入完成才记成功，取消 / 失败会清理临时目录。
- **安全与一致性**：跨 App 的相同文件不再被当成可互相替代；重复清理不能选中某个 App 的最后一份；上次中断的导出在重开后显示「已中断」；清理 14 个无用本地化 key，中英文 813 个 key 对齐。
- **界面**：修复空间变化页底部被悬浮 Tab Bar 遮挡；补充全局搜索、空间趋势、导出选择面板的中英文文案。

验证：23 个本地测试程序、9 条模拟器 UI 流程、Debug 模拟器与 Release arm64 构建、`xcodebuild analyze` 全部通过，编译警告 0 条。

已知边界：本轮 IPA 未签名，未在真机安装；超大 App 的冷扫描耗时、App Group 签名、分享 / 存储到「文件」以及强制中断场景仍需真机验收。空间趋势样本不足时显示「—」，这是预期行为。

**遇到问题或有建议，欢迎到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/hseons/WQManager/issues) 提出**。请尽量附上系统版本、App 名称、复现步骤和截图；崩溃日志可配合附件中的 dSYM 定位。

附件为**未签名 IPA**、SHA-256 和 dSYM，请按项目说明保留 App Group 权限重新签名后安装。

apps.name: Andarium
apps.subtitle: Android on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Andarium runs the Android system on iPhone and iPad. It is built on the Kernarium runtime, which runs a real Linux kernel natively and emulates only the code of the apps, with graphics drawn through Metal.

It needs iOS 26 or later. With a free Apple ID, Android gets less memory. JIT is optional and experimental.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Andarium uses the camera only when you turn on Camera, so that apps in the virtual machine can use it.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Apps running in Andarium use this to connect to devices on your local network, such as printers, media servers and computers, and ADB over network uses it to let a computer on your network connect to Andarium. Internet access doesn't need it.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Andarium shares this device's location only when you turn on Location, so that apps in the virtual machine can use it.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Andarium records from the microphone only when you turn on Microphone, so that apps in the virtual machine can use it.

versions.localizedDescription:
New: root access with Magisk, Android's system libraries translated ahead of time, 120 Hz on ProMotion devices, Add to Home Screen, VoiceOver support, a frame rate that drops only when the device is very hot, text messages you write, and a notice when a newer version is out.

Fixed: Wi-Fi dropping when you return to Andarium, face scans in some apps that use the front camera, connections hanging after a move from Wi-Fi to cellular data, apps failing to reach servers after the network returns. VP9 videos now play with the hardware decoder.
